rows.translation: Guitarra
rows.context: Guitar course · title

rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: De la primera nota al punteig amb els dits, el blues i els solos
rows.context: Guitar course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hola, guitarra
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 “Hello, guitar” · title

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Agafa-la, afina-la i toca les primeres notes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 “Hello, guitar” · unit summary

rows.translation: Coneix la teva guitarra
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · title

rows.translation: Sis cordes, una feina
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: La corda més gruixuda és la més greu. Quan toques, és la més propera a la cara. En diem corda 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Gira per afinar
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Cada corda té una clavilla al claviller. Girar-la canvia l’altura del so. Timbre t’escolta i et diu cap on.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina és la corda 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La més gruixuda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La més prima
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La del mig
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Les cordes es compten de la més prima (1) a la més gruixuda (6).
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Polsa la corda més gruixuda i deixa-la ressonar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara la més prima, la corda 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Les cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · title

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: De gruixuda a prima: E, A, D, G, B, E. Prova: En Albert Dibuixa Grans Barques Enormes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Toca les cordes 6, 5 i 4, d’una en una.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara les cordes 3, 2 i 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Com es diu la corda 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Quina és més aguda?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La primera opció
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La segona opció
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Repàs de les cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Les primeres notes amb trasts
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · title

rows.translation: Prem just darrere del trast
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Posa la punta del dit just darrere del trast metàl·lic, no al damunt. Prem prou perquè soni net.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 1, trast 1, primer dit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Corda 1, trast 3, tercer dit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.
rows.translation: A l’aire, trast 1, trast 3: E, F, G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: On has de prémer?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Just darrere del trast
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al damunt del trast
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Between two frets, in the middle
rows.translation: Al mig de dos trasts
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Amunt i avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-3 “Your first fretted notes” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: El teu primer acord: E menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · title

rows.translation: Dos dits, sis cordes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E menor es toca amb dos dits al trast 2, a les cordes 5 i 4. Sonen totes les cordes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rasca avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Rasca les sis cordes de gruixuda a prima amb un moviment fluid. Mantén el canell relaxat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repte dels primers passos
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · title

rows.translation: Res de nou, només tu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Aquest repte combina tota la unitat: les cordes a l’aire, E, F i G a la corda 1, i E menor. Respira entre passos.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: De gruixuda a prima, les cordes a l’aire són…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: En Albert Dibuixa Grans Barques Enormes: E A D G B E, de la corda 6 a la corda 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repàs de prima a gruixuda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Quina és més greu?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E, F i G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb: tres notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · title

rows.translation: La teva primera cançó
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb necessita tres notes: la corda 2 a l’aire és B, el trast 2 de la corda 3 és A i la corda 3 a l’aire és G. Toca l’A amb el segon dit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Corda 3, trast 2, segon dit. És A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: corda 2 a l’aire, després corda 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Primera meitat

rows.translation: Primeres melodies
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 “First melodies” · title

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Notes a les cordes 1 i 2, lectura de tabulatures i les teves dues primeres melodies.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 “First melodies” · unit summary

rows.translation: Tres notes a la corda 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · title

rows.translation: Corda 2: B, C i D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: La corda 2 funciona com la corda 1. A l’aire és B. El trast 1 amb el primer dit és C. El trast 3 amb el tercer dit és D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polsa la corda 2 a l’aire. És B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Corda 2, trast 1, primer dit. És C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Corda 2, trast 3, tercer dit. És D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Amb quin dit toques el trast 3?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Primer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Segon dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tercer dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quart dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Un dit per trast: al trast 1, el dit 1; al trast 2, el dit 2; al trast 3, el dit 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El polze darrere del mànec
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Recolza el polze a la part posterior del mànec, darrere del segon dit. Així els dits es poden arquejar i recolzar sobre les puntes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Amunt i avall a la corda 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Llegir tabulatures
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · title

rows.translation: La tabulatura és un mapa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: La tabulatura té sis línies, una per corda, amb la corda 1 a dalt. Un número indica el trast que has de prémer. Un 0 vol dir tocar la corda a l’aire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: A la tabulatura, un 3 a la línia de dalt vol dir…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 6, trast 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 1, trast 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tocar tres cordes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: La línia de dalt és la corda 1, la més prima. El número és el trast.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Línia de dalt: 0, 1, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A 0 on the second line means…
rows.translation: Un 0 a la segona línia vol dir…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Tocar la corda 2 a l’aire
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: No tocar la corda 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Prémer la corda 2 al trast 10
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Segona línia: 3, 1, 0.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Quina nota és aquesta?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Baixa l’escala
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Notes llargues i curtes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · title

rows.source: A note that lasts two beats
rows.translation: Una nota que dura dues pulsacions
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Una blanca dura dues pulsacions. Polsa una vegada, compta un, dos, i deixa-la sonar fins a la nota següent.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
rows.translation: Quant dura una blanca?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una pulsació
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dues pulsacions
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quatre pulsacions
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: La meitat d’un compàs de quatre pulsacions són dues pulsacions. Una negra dura una pulsació.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Canvia de corda amb poc moviment
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Passar de la corda 2 a la corda 1 és un moviment molt petit. Mantén la mà que polsa a prop de les cordes per preparar la nota següent.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Trast 3 de la corda 2, després corda 1 a l’aire. Aixeca el dit mentre polses.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C i D a la corda 2, després E, F i G a la corda 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: D’una corda a l’altra
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · title

rows.translation: Una melodia de Beethoven
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Aquesta melodia és de la Novena simfonia de Beethoven. Fa servir C, D, E, F i G, i es mou sobretot per graus conjunts.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: La primera frase, a poc a poc: E E F G G F E D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Després: C C D E E D D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Llarga, curta, llarga
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Cada frase acaba amb un ritme viu: una nota més llarga, una de ràpida i una de sostinguda. Compta un-i-dos i intercala la ràpida a la i.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Primera frase
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Tres notes i un salt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Aquesta cançó infantil camina per C, D i E, i després salta fins a G. El salt va de la corda 1 a l’aire al trast 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: corda 1 a l’aire, baixa a la corda 2 i torna.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D a la corda 2, després E i G a la corda 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
rows.translation: Cançó: Cartes en una capsa de sabates
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · title

rows.translation: Una balada en dues cordes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Cartes en una capsa de sabates és un original de Timbre, una balada lenta en C. La tornada fa servir les cordes 1 i 2, i el motiu comença amb el ritme llarg-curt de l’Oda a l’alegria. Trobaràs la cançó sencera a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: El motiu: C i D a la corda 2, després E, F i G a la corda 1, i torna a D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: El motiu

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
rows.translation: La tornada acaba a la tònica?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sí, sembla que ha acabat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: No, it wants to go on
rows.translation: No, demana continuar
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La tornada
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cartes en una capsa de sabates
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de melodies
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · title

rows.translation: Sis notes, dues cordes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Res de nou: E, F i G a la corda 1; B, C i D a la corda 2. Comença a poc a poc i després mantén un tempo constant.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina nota és la corda 2 a l’aire?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Did the tune go up or down?
rows.translation: La melodia ha anat amunt o avall?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Les sis notes, de greu a agut.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sis notes avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria, una mica més ràpid
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb, més ràpid
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · challenge gtr-2-6 “Melody challenge” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Primers acords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · title

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: E menor, E, A menor i A, amb un so net, i els primers canvis d’acord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: Acords nets
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · title

rows.translation: Amb les puntes, no amb els tous
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Prem amb les puntes dels dits, arquejats com un pont, perquè cap dit toqui la corda de sota. Amb les ungles curtes és molt més fàcil.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Comprova cada corda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Polsa les cordes d’una en una, de gruixuda a prima. Un so apagat vol dir que un dit toca aquella corda. Ajusta’l i torna-la a polsar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: E menor, corda per corda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Una corda sona apagada. Quina n’és la causa més probable?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un dit la toca
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Has rascat massa a poc a poc
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La pua és massa prima
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Si la punta d’un dit toca una corda veïna, no la deixa ressonar. Arqueja més els dits.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: E major: afegeix-hi un dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · title

rows.translation: E menor més un dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Mantén la posició d’E menor i afegeix el primer dit a la corda 3, trast 1. Aquesta sola nota transforma menor en major.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Brillant i fosc
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Els acords majors solen sonar brillants i estables. Els menors sonen més foscos. E i E menor només es diferencien en una nota.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Major o menor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: E, corda per corda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: A menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · title

rows.translation: La mateixa posició, una corda més enllà
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A menor és la posició d’E desplaçada una corda cap a les primes: dits 2 i 3 al trast 2, dit 1 a la corda 2, trast 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Comença a la fonamental
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: La fonamental és la nota que dona nom a l’acord. A A menor és la corda 5 a l’aire: comença el rascat allà i omet la corda 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
rows.translation: Quina corda omets a A menor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: La fonamental d’A menor és la corda 5 a l’aire. Comença el rascat allà.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin acord és menor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A menor, corda per corda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Tres dits en fila
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: A agrupa els dits 1, 2 i 3 al trast 2, a les cordes 4, 3 i 2. Rasca des de la corda 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hi ha poc espai? Inclina’ls
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Si els dits estan atapeïts, inclina’ls una mica perquè cadascun quedi just darrere del trast. Deixa lliure la corda 1 perquè soni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: A quin trast poses els tres dits a A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Trast 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Trast 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Trast 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A, corda per corda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.translation: D’E menor a A menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · title

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.translation: Mou la posició, no els dits
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: D’E menor a A menor, els dits 2 i 3 salten junts a les cordes 4 i 3. Després, el dit 1 arriba a la corda 2. La mà gairebé no es mou.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Canvia abans, arriba a l’u
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Rasca un cop i aprofita la resta del compàs per canviar. Intenta arribar al nou acord just al primer temps. La velocitat vindrà després, tota sola.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Com s’han de moure els dits entre acords?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D’un en un
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tan amunt com puguis
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Junts, mantenint la posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Moure els dits en bloc és més ràpid i precís. Mantén-los baixos, just damunt de les cordes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D’A a E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · title

rows.translation: Visualitza primer la posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Tots els dits es mouen d’A a E. Visualitza la posició d’E abans d’aixecar-los i mou-los junts. Dirigeix el dit 2 cap a la corda 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.translation: Cançó: Pols al tauler de comandament
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · title

rows.translation: Country amb E i A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pols al tauler de comandament és un original de Timbre: country en A. Cada estrofa acaba amb dos compassos d’E i dos d’A, el canvi que has après. Visualitza la posició, mou-te abans i arriba al primer temps. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Això acaba a la tònica?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Sobre E: B i E a l’aire, D al trast 3 de la corda 2, C sostingut al trast 2 i G sostingut al trast 1 de la corda 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: El final de l’estrofa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de canvis d’acord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · title

rows.translation: Quatre acords, canvis nets
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Res de nou: E menor, E, A menor i A. Forma cada posició amb un so net i mantén els canvis regulars.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Quin dit transforma E menor en E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dit 4 a la corda 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dit 2 a la corda 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dit 1 a la corda 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: El dit 1 a la corda 3, trast 1, toca l’única nota que fa E major.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rascats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · title

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Cops avall, corxeres avall-amunt, accents i una mà que no s’atura.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · unit summary

rows.translation: Un rascat per pulsació
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · title

rows.translation: Negres
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Una negra dura una pulsació. Rasca avall a cada pulsació i compta en veu alta: un, dos, tres, quatre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rasca amb el canell
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: El moviment surt del canell i l’avantbraç relaxats, com si t’espolsessis aigua de la mà. Un braç rígid fa un so aspre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Quants rascats de negra omplen un compàs de quatre temps?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dos
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quatre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Vuit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Avall i amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · title

rows.translation: Corxeres: avall-amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Divideix cada pulsació en dues. Rasca avall al número i amunt a la i: un i dos i. Són vuit rascats per compàs.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
rows.translation: On cau el rascat amunt?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A la i
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al número
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només al quart temps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Avall al número, amunt a la i. La mà baixa i puja una vegada per pulsació.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Més suau en pujar
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Els rascats amunt són naturalment més suaus. En pujar, frega només les tres o quatre cordes més primes. Això dona empenta al ritme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Accentua el primer temps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · title

rows.translation: Reforça l’u
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Un accent és una nota una mica més forta. Rasca el primer temps més fort que la resta. Així tothom sap on comença el compàs.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quin temps porta l’accent?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El tercer temps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cada i
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El primer temps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: El primer temps inicia el compàs. Un primer rascat una mica més fort t’ajuda a tu i a qui t’escolta a seguir el ritme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Compta els compassos
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Digues el número del compàs al primer temps: un, dos, tres, quatre; dos, dos, tres, quatre. Així sempre saps on ets.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mantén la mà en moviment
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · title

rows.translation: La mà com un pèndol
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: La mà que rasca va avall i amunt tota l’estona, com un pèndol. Per ometre un rascat, continua el moviment sense tocar les cordes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.translation: Per ometre un rascat, la mà…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
rows.translation: Continua sense tocar les cordes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: S’atura i espera
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Rasca el doble de fort
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Una mà que no s’atura manté el ritme constant. El rascat omès és un moviment que no toca les cordes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El rascat folk
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · title

rows.translation: Avall, avall-amunt, amunt-avall-amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Aquest patró impulsa innombrables cançons. Al tercer temps, la mà baixa sense tocar les cordes i després les rasca amunt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: En aquest patró, quin temps no té rascat al número?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tres
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Al tres, la mà baixa sense tocar les cordes i després rasca amunt a la i.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Cançó: Ràdio de marea baixa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · title

rows.translation: Reggae a les is
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ràdio de marea baixa és un original de Timbre: reggae relaxat amb E menor i A. La guitarra només toca a les is. Mantén la mà avall i amunt, evita les cordes a cada número i toca-les a cada i. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: On toca la guitarra a Ràdio de marea baixa?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Només a les is
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A cada número
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només al primer temps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: El baix i la bateria marquen els números. La guitarra respon entremig, a les is.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de rascats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · title

rows.translation: Mà constant, quatre acords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Res de nou: negres, corxeres i el rascat folk amb els acords que coneixes. Mantén la mà en moviment i accentua el primer temps.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Corxeres avall-amunt: on són els rascats amunt?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A cada i
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només al dos i al quatre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Més acords oberts
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · title

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D i D menor, dues progressions clàssiques i canvis en un minut.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: Una escala de tres esglaons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: C puja com una escala: dit 3 a la corda 5, trast 3; dit 2 a la corda 4, trast 2; dit 1 a la corda 2, trast 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
rows.translation: Quina corda omets a C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: La fonamental de C és a la corda 5, trast 3. Comença el rascat allà.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: D’A menor a C: un dit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: Els dits 1 i 2 es queden exactament on són. Només es mou el dit 3, de la corda 3 a la corda 5, trast 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ample i brillant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: G s’estén: dit 2 a la corda 6, trast 3; dit 1 a la corda 5, trast 2; dit 3 a la corda 1, trast 3. Sonen les sis cordes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
rows.translation: A G, quines cordes sonen a l’aire?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cordes 2, 3 i 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cordes 1 i 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cap
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Comença pel baix
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: En canviar, col·loca primer el dit de la corda més greu. És la primera nota del rascat i et dona un moment per posar els altres.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: D i D menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · title

rows.translation: Un petit triangle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D és a les tres cordes més primes: dit 1 a la corda 3, trast 2; dit 3 a la corda 2, trast 3; dit 2 a la corda 1, trast 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
rows.translation: On comença el rascat d’un acord de D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: La fonamental de D és la corda 4 a l’aire. Les cordes 5 i 6 no sonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D menor: una nota més greu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: A D menor, la nota de la corda 1 baixa al trast 1. Recol·loca els dits: dit 1 a la corda 1, dit 2 a la corda 3; el dit 3 es queda a la corda 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G, C i D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · title

rows.translation: Tres acords, cançons sense fi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: La tonalitat és la llar d’una cançó. En G, els acords G, C i D fan gairebé tota la feina. Moltíssimes cançons folk i rock només fan servir aquests tres.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Sempre arribes tard al canvi. Què t’ajuda més?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Rascar més fort
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ometre aquell acord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Anar més lent i moure’t abans
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Els canvis lents i anticipats creen l’hàbit. La velocitat ve tota sola.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: A menor, C, G, D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · title

rows.translation: Quatre acords seguits
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Una progressió és una seqüència d’acords que es repeteix. A menor, C, G, D comença fosca i s’il·lumina mentre puja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Canvis en un minut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Sense l’app, tria dos acords i alterna’ls durant un minut, amb un rascat per acord. Compta els canvis nets i supera la marca demà. Comença amb D i D menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
rows.translation: En els canvis d’un minut, què comptes?

rows.translation: Canvis nets
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cordes que trastegen

rows.translation: Segons per acord

rows.translation: Cançó: Temps d’estels
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · title

rows.translation: Quatre acords, un bucle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Temps d’estels és un original de Timbre: pop lluminós de foguera amb G, D, E menor i C, una vegada i una altra. Canvia abans i col·loca primer el dit de la corda més greu. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Quin acord de Temps d’estels omet les cordes 5 i 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: La fonamental de D és la corda 4 a l’aire, així que les cordes 5 i 6 no sonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: L’estrofa afegeix A a la corda 3, trast 2: la nota del dit 1 a D. G a l’aire, A i després B a l’aire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte d’acords oberts
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · title

rows.translation: Vuit acords oberts
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Res de nou: C, G, D i D menor s’afegeixen a E menor, E, A menor i A. Canvia abans, rasca regularment i deixa ressonar cada acord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quin acord omet les cordes 5 i 6?

rows.translation: Melodies a les cordes 3 i 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 “Melodies on strings 3 and 4” · title

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G i A a la corda 3; D, E i F a la corda 4; l’escala de C major i dues melodies tradicionals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 “Melodies on strings 3 and 4” · unit summary

rows.translation: Notes a la corda 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · title

rows.translation: Corda 3: G i A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: La corda 3 a l’aire és G. Posa el dit 2 al trast 2 i tens A. La regla és la mateixa: el dit correspon al trast.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polsa la corda 3 a l’aire. És G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Amb quin dit toques el trast 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G i A a la corda 3, després B, C i D a la corda 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: G up to D and back
rows.translation: De G a D i tornada
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Notes a la corda 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · title

rows.translation: Corda 4: D, E i F
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: La corda 4 a l’aire és D. El trast 2 és E i el trast 3 és F. Mantén el polze baix darrere del mànec perquè els dits hi arribin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polsa la corda 4 a l’aire. És D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: Trast 2, després trast 3: E, després F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Quin nom comparteixen la corda 4 a l’aire i la corda 2, trast 3?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Totes dues són D, separades per una octava: el mateix nom de nota, l’una més aguda que l’altra.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin D és més agut?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E i F a la corda 4, després G i A a la corda 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Cinc notes, amunt i avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: L’escala de C major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · title

rows.translation: Una nota més: C
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Posa el dit 3 a la corda 5, trast 3. És C, la nota on comença l’escala de C major.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Corda 5, trast 3, tercer dit. És C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Una escala és una escala de mà
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: Una escala puja nota a nota d’una lletra a la mateixa lletra una octava més amunt. C major només fa servir lletres sense alteracions: C D E F G A B C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Corda 5, trast 3, després cordes 4, 3 i 2. Ves a poc a poc.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Quantes lletres diferents hi ha a C major?

rows.translation: Cinc
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sis
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Set
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, i després C una altra vegada, una octava més amunt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: C major, amunt i avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un clàssic de Nova Orleans
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Aquest espiritual tradicional es va convertir en un estàndard de jazz. Fa servir C, D, E, F i G a les cordes 5, 4 i 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: L’inici: C, E, F i després G a l’aire.

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Una anacrusi són unes notes que porten a un temps fort. Aquí el primer temps és un silenci, i C, E i F porten a un G llarg.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: La tornada: E E D C, després C E G G G F.

rows.translation: Espiritual tradicional

rows.translation: Tres temps per compàs
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace és a tres temps: compta un, dos, tres, amb el pes a l’u. Les notes són a les cordes 4, 3 i 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
rows.translation: Quants temps té cada compàs aquí?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Un compàs de tres temps es balanceja suaument: fort, fluix, fluix.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: L’inici: D, G, B G, B, A. Cordes 4, 3 i 2 a l’aire, més A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Després baixa: G, E, D, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: La part aguda: de B a l’aire a D al trast 3, i després baixa per B, G i A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Cançó: Halogen
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · title

rows.translation: Un riff a les cordes 3, 4 i 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Halogen és un original de Timbre: rock desèrtic en D menor. El riff fa servir les notes que has après: D a l’aire, F al trast 3, G a l’aire i C a la corda 5, trast 3. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Corda 4 a l’aire, F al trast 3, corda 3 a l’aire i C al trast 3 de la corda 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Primer compàs, dues vegades

rows.translation: Segon compàs, dues vegades

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · challenge gtr-6-6 “Lower-strings challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Res de nou: totes les notes de C a la corda 5 fins a G a la corda 1, i totes dues melodies. Mantén el polze baix i els dits arquejats.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · challenge gtr-6-6 “Lower-strings challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: On és A a la corda 3?

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C major des de la corda 5 fins a G a la corda 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · challenge gtr-6-6 “Lower-strings challenge” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tot avall

rows.translation: Cançons amb acords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 “Songs with chords” · title

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: Un F petit, D7 i dues cançons tradicionals amb acords i melodia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 “Songs with chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: El F petit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · title

rows.translation: F sense celleta
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Aquest F petit fa servir quatre cordes. El dit 1 s’estira sobre les cordes 1 i 2 al trast 1; el dit 2 va a la corda 3, trast 2, i el dit 3 a la corda 4, trast 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Gira el dit, no aixafis
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Inclina una mica el dit 1 cap al polze. La vora més òssia prem dues cordes més fàcilment. Comprova que la corda 2 soni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: A menor, C, D, F
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Aquesta progressió puja pas a pas des d’A menor fins al nou F. Rasca dues vegades per acord i canvia abans.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Greensleeves: els acords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · title

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Aquesta melodia anglesa té més de 400 anys. Ja coneixes tots els acords: A menor, C, G, E menor, F i E. És a tres temps: rasca un cop per compàs i després a cada pulsació.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
rows.translation: Quines cordes no sonen amb el F petit?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cordes 5 i 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cordes 1 i 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només la corda 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: El F petit comença a la corda 4. Comença el rascat allà i omet les cordes 5 i 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Greensleeves: la melodia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · title

rows.translation: Sostinguts: un trast més amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Un sostingut apuja una nota un trast. Greensleeves fa servir G sostingut a la corda 3, trast 1, i F sostingut a la corda 4, trast 4. Arriba-hi amb el dit petit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: G sostingut, A, B: corda 3 als trasts 1 i 2, després corda 2 a l’aire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: L’inici: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Primera frase musical
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un sostingut mou una nota…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un trast més amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un trast més avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A la corda següent
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Sostingut vol dir un trast més amunt. G sostingut és entre G i A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
