rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Només D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: B i G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B a la corda 3 i G a la corda 1 es queden al lloc. Només es mou la corda 2, de D a E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Més amunt del mànec
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Els mateixos quatre acords també són més amunt: G als trasts 7, 8 i 7; E menor als 9, 8 i 7; C als 9, 8 i 8; D als 7, 7 i 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Arpegis de tríades
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title

rows.translation: Polsa-les per separat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Toca les notes d’una tríada d’una en una i tindràs un arpegi. Al llarg d’una progressió, les notes creen la seva pròpia melodia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Arpegis, trasts 2 a 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Què és un arpegi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.translation: Un acord tocat nota a nota
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un acord rascat dues vegades
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una escala tocada ràpid
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Arpegis en corxeres
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Escolta la veu aguda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Les notes agudes fan G, G, G, F sostingut: gairebé quietes mentre els acords canvien a sota. Una nota compartida per dos acords és una nota comuna; per això les tríades sonen tan fluides.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: La nota aguda ha anat amunt o avall?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Arpegis, trasts 5 a 9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cançó: Pista de patinatge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title

rows.translation: Tríades a la pista de ball
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pista de patinatge és un original de Timbre: pop de ball retro amb G, E menor, C i D, les quatre tríades entre els trasts 2 i 5. Les posicions petites a les cordes agudes sonen brillants i precises, com una segona guitarra. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: El bucle de Pista de patinatge és u, sis, quatre i cinc de G. Quin acord és el sis?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Compta amunt per G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. L’acord sobre el 6 és menor: E menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tríades, des de la corda aguda avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de tríades
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · title

rows.translation: Posicions petites, tot el mànec
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Res de nou: tríades majors i menors, les inversions, G, E menor, C i D en dos llocs, i els arpegis. Fes moviments petits.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Una tríada menor és una tríada major amb…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La fonamental un trast més amunt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La tercera un trast més avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una nota extra a dalt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Setenes i disposicions de jazz
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · title

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Setenes majors, menors i de dominant, obertes i amb celleta; ii–V–I i acompanyament swing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary

rows.translation: Acords de setena major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title

rows.translation: Afegeix la setena
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Un acord de setena major afegeix la nota un trast per sota de l’octava de la fonamental. Fa suau i somiador un acord major simple. Cmaj7 obert és C amb el dit 1 aixecat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 és C més quina nota?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: B bemoll
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: La setena major és un trast per sota de l’octava de la fonamental: B, just sota C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fmaj7: allibera la corda aguda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Toca el F petit, però amb el dit 1 prement només la corda 2. La corda 1 a l’aire, E, és la setena major de F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Acords de setena menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title

rows.translation: Menor suau
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Un acord de setena menor afegeix la nota dos trasts per sota de l’octava de la fonamental. Sona suau, entre fosc i brillant. Am7 és A menor amb el dit 3 aixecat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dm7 i Em7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: dit 2 a la corda 3, trast 2, i dit 1 estirat sobre les cordes 2 i 1 al trast 1. Em7: només el dit 2 a la corda 5, trast 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 és A menor més quina nota?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: La setena menor és dos trasts per sota de l’octava de la fonamental: G, dos trasts sota A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Setenes amb fonamental a la corda 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title

rows.translation: Cmaj7 al trast 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: El dit 1 prem la corda 5 al trast 3 i s’estira fins a la corda 1. El dit 3 va a la corda 4; el dit 2, a la corda 3; el dit 4, a la corda 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dm7 i D7 al trast 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 és la celleta d’A menor amb el dit petit aixecat. D7 és la celleta d’A amb els dits 3 i 4 a les cordes 4 i 2. El nom de tots dos ve de la corda 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 al trast 5. On és la fonamental?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 4, trast 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 5, trast 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 1, trast 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Com tots els acords amb posició d’A, pren el nom de la nota a la corda 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El ii–V–I
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title

rows.translation: Dos, cinc, u
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: El moviment preferit del jazz: l’acord de la segona nota de la tonalitat, després el de la cinquena i tornada a casa. En C és Dm7, G7 i Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G7 amb celleta
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Toca la posició d’E7 amb celleta al trast 3: dit 1 sobre les sis cordes, dit 3 a la corda 5 i dit 2 a la corda 3. La fonamental és a la corda 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: En C, quin acord és el ii?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de C: C és u, D és dos. L’acord de setena construït sobre D és D menor setena.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Curt i nítid
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: En el jazz sovint es deixa sonar cada acord només un instant. Prem quan rasquis i afluixa de seguida: els acords començaran a tenir swing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Acompanyament swing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title

rows.translation: El xarleston
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Els guitarristes de swing acompanyen amb acords curts que responen a la banda. El ritme de xarleston toca al primer temps i a la i amb swing del dos, i després deixa espai.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: ii–V–I en G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: En G, el dos, cinc, u és Am7, D7 i Gmaj7. Am7 és la celleta d’E menor setena al trast 5; Gmaj7 omet la corda 5 i té la fonamental a la corda 6, trast 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Cançó: Sortida tardana
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title

rows.translation: Un ii–V–I en bucle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sortida tardana és un original de Timbre: lo-fi en C amb Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 i Am7. És un ii–V–I amb l’acord del sisè grau per recomençar. Acompanya’l amb setenes amb celleta i xarleston. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: A Sortida tardana, quin acord és el V?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Compta amunt per C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. L’acord de setena sobre G és G7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte d’acords de jazz
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title

rows.translation: Setenes amb swing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Res de nou: setenes majors, menors i de dominant, obertes i amb celleta, i ii–V–I en C i G. Mantén els acords curts i el swing constant.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Quina setena és un trast sota l’octava de la fonamental?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La setena menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La setena major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: L’escala major en posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G major en dues octaves al trast 2, graus de l’escala i acords, i els modes dòric i mixolidi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary

rows.translation: La posició de l’escala major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title

rows.translation: Tons i semitons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Un semitò és un trast; un to, dos. Totes les escales majors pugen to, to, semitò, to, to, to, semitò. Aquest patró dona al mode major el seu so.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G major al trast 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Posa el dit 1 al trast 2 i dona un trast a cada dit, fins al trast 5. Des de G a la corda 6, trast 3, l’escala puja per les cordes 6, 5 i 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Corda 6: trasts 3 i 5, dits 2 i 4. Corda 5: trasts 2 i 3, dits 1 i 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Corda 5, trast 5; després corda 4: trasts 2, 4 i 5. Tornada a G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: On són els semitons en una escala major?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Entre les notes 3 i 4, i 7 i 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Entre cada parella
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Entre les notes 1 i 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: To, to, semitò: el primer semitò va de 3 a 4. To, to, to, semitò: el segon va de 7 a 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Una octava, amunt i avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Dues octaves en posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title

rows.translation: La segona octava
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: La mateixa posició continua: A, B i C a la corda 3; D i E a la corda 2; F sostingut i G a la corda 1. La mà no es mou.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Corda 3: trasts 2, 4, 5. Corda 2: trasts 3, 5. Corda 1: trasts 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: L’octava aguda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: En aquesta posició, quin dit toca el trast 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: El dit 1 és al trast 2; per tant, el trast 5 correspon al dit 4, el dit petit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Dues octaves, de G a G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.translation: Una nadala construïda sobre l’escala
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, arranjada per Lowell Mason el 1839, comença amb l’escala de G major baixant directament des de dalt. Ja coneixes totes les notes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World, en posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Graus de l’escala i acords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title

rows.translation: Numera les notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Numera l’escala des de G: G és 1, A és 2, i així fins a F sostingut, 7. Els músics fan servir aquests números per parlar de melodies i acords en qualsevol tonalitat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.translation: En G major, quina nota és el 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Un acord sobre cada nota
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Apila notes alternes de l’escala sobre cada grau i obtindràs els acords de la tonalitat. Sobre 1, 4 i 5 són majors; sobre 2, 3 i 6, menors. En G: G, C i D; després A menor, B menor i E menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: En G major, quin acord es construeix sobre el 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: La sisena nota és E, i els acords sobre 2, 3 i 6 són menors. Apila E, G i B: E menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: L’escala per terceres
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: A dòric
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title

rows.translation: Mateixes notes, nova tònica
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Toca les notes de G major però fes d’A la tònica: l’escala es torna menor. Aquest so és A dòric, un mode de G major: mateixa posició, nova nota inicial.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Comença en A, corda 6, trast 5, amb el dit 4, i puja pels mateixos trasts fins a A a la corda 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Quina nota fa A dòric més brillant que A menor natural?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: F sostingut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: A menor natural té F. El dòric manté el F sostingut de G major: un punt brillant en una escala menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodia en A dòric
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodia en A dòric, amb fluïdesa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: D mixolidi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · title

rows.translation: Comença en D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Ara fes de D la tònica. Les notes de G major de D a D fan D mixolidi: una escala major amb la setena un trast més avall. És molt habitual en folk, rock i melodies de violí tradicional.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Des de D a la corda 5, trast 5, puja per la mateixa posició fins a D a la corda 2, trast 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D major té C sostingut. D mixolidi té…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: El mixolidi abaixa la setena un trast: el C de G major esdevé la nota que li dona el caràcter.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodia en D mixolidi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mode a mode
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Qualsevol nota de l’escala major pot ser la tònica. Des de G és major; des d’A, dòric; des de D, mixolidi; des d’E, menor natural. Mateixos trasts, diferents caràcters.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: D mixolidi, dues vegades
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cançó: Dia de mercat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · title

rows.translation: Un motiu en segona posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Dia de mercat és un original de Timbre: pop lluminós en G amb ritme highlife, la música de guitarra brillant de l’Àfrica occidental. El motiu només usa notes de G major: encaixa a l’escala en segona posició. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Els acords de Dia de mercat són G, B menor, C i D. Sobre quins graus de l’escala són?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G és 1, B és 3, C és 4 i D és 5. L’acord sobre el 3 és menor en tota tonalitat major: B menor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D al trast 3 de la corda 2, B al trast 4 de la corda 3, D, E al trast 5 amb el dit 4, després D i B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte d’escales
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · title

rows.translation: Una posició, tres caràcters
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Res de nou: G major en dues octaves, l’escala per terceres, A dòric i D mixolidi. Mantén un dit per trast.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: To, to, semitò, to, to, to, semitò forma…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: L’escala major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La pentatònica menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Quin mode comença a la segona nota de G major?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pentatònica major i expressió solista
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · title

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Pentatònica major, lligats i lliscaments de country, refilets, fraseig, dolçor i aspror sobre el blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · unit summary

rows.translation: La pentatònica major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title

rows.translation: Fes baixar la posició
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Mou la posició pentatònica menor del trast 5 al trast 2 i fes d’A la tònica: es torna dolça i major. És la pentatònica d’A major: A, B, C sostingut, E i F sostingut.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Des d’A a la corda 6, trast 5; trasts 2 i 4 de les cordes 5 i 4; A al trast 2 de la corda 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Quines notes té la pentatònica d’A major?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C sostingut, E, F sostingut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Cinc notes de l’escala d’A major, sense els dos semitons. La posició menor al trast 5 té A, C, D, E i G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.translation: Pentatònica d’A major, amunt i avall
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una posició, dues tonalitats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Aquesta posició al trast 2 també és la pentatònica de F sostingut menor si parteix de F sostingut. La nota que fas servir de tònica decideix quina toques.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Una frase dolça
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lligats i lliscaments de country
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · title

rows.translation: Lliga fins al mode major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: En el country agraden els lligats ascendents dins d’aquesta posició: d’E a F sostingut a la corda 4, d’A a B a la corda 3. Polsa la primera nota i lliga la segona.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Corda 4: polsa al trast 2 i fes caure el dit 3 al trast 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Motiu 1: dos lligats ascendents
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Llisca fins a C sostingut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Ara fes lliscar el dit 3 a la corda 3 del trast 4 al 6, de B a C sostingut, i torna lliscant a la posició.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Dit 3 a la corda 3, trast 4. Polsa i llisca fins al trast 6 sense aixecar-lo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Motiu 2: el lliscament
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Tots dos motius
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Refilets i entrades amb lliscament
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · title

rows.translation: Un refilet
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Un refilet alterna ràpidament dues notes: una polsada, després lligat ascendent i descendent, una vegada i una altra. Fes-lo regular abans de fer-lo ràpid.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Corda 3: trasts 2 i 4. Polsa un cop i fes lligats amunt i avall amb el dit 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Un refilet lent
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Refilets a les cordes 3 i 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Entra en una nota lliscant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Comença un trast per sota de la nota que vols i llisca amunt mentre polses. La nota de destí és la que compta: arriba-hi just a la pulsació.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Quan entres en una nota lliscant, quina cau a la pulsació?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La de destí
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La del trast inferior
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Totes dues alhora
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: El lliscament comença just abans de la pulsació perquè la nota de destí hi arribi exactament.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Entra a cada frase lliscant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Dolç i aspre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · title

rows.translation: Dues posicions, un blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Sobre un blues en A, funcionen totes dues posicions. La pentatònica major al trast 2 sona dolça; la menor al trast 5, aspra. Els bons músics les alternen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dolç, al trast 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Aspre, al trast 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Quina posició sona més dolça sobre A7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A major, al trast 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A menor, al trast 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: La pentatònica major té C sostingut, la tercera d’A7. El C de la posició menor hi crea fricció: aquesta fricció és el blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Aspre i després dolç
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Fes una pregunta aspra al trast 5 i respon dolçament al trast 2. Desplaça la mà durant la nota llarga i acaba totes dues frases en A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Pregunta i resposta, amb fluïdesa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Fraseja com si cantessis
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · title

rows.translation: Deixa espai
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Els grans solos respiren. Toca una frase curta, fes un silenci de durada semblant i respon. El silenci dona pes a les notes següents.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Frases i silencis
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Després d’una frase de dues pulsacions, quant pots descansar?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Gens: continua tocant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una durada semblant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sempre un compàs sencer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Repeteix i després canvia el final
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Toca una frase dues vegades igual i després canvia’n només el final. Qui escolta reconeix la repetició i para atenció al gir.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repeteix i varia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vibrato a les notes llargues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Sostén cada nota llarga i fes-la oscil·lar empenyent i afluixant poc i regularment. Fes-ho estret: l’altura ha d’oscil·lar, no desviar-se.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repeteix i varia amb vibrato
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cançó: Estroboscopi a càmera lenta
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · title

rows.translation: Una posició per a tot el bucle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Estroboscopi a càmera lenta és un original de Timbre: synth-pop en A amb F sostingut menor, D, A i E. La posició al trast 2 encaixa amb tot el bucle: pentatònica d’A major, també de F sostingut menor. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Escolta el primer acord. Major o menor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Sobre F sostingut menor i D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Sobre A i E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Quines notes de la posició pertanyen a l’acord d’E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E i B
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C sostingut i F sostingut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A i C sostingut
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E és E, G sostingut i B. La posició té E i B però no G sostingut: recolza’t en aquestes dues notes sobre E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El teu solo sobre el bucle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte d’expressió solista
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · title

rows.translation: Dolç, aspre i cantant
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Res de nou: pentatònica major, lligats ascendents, lliscaments, refilets i totes dues posicions sobre el blues. Deixa espai i acaba en A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Si baixes la posició menor del trast 5 al 2, toques…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pentatònica de D menor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Pentatònica d’A major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Forma de cançó i arranjaments
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 “Song form and arranging” · title

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Estrofa, tornada i AABA; intros, codes, textures, ornaments i el teu arranjament de Down by the Riverside.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 “Song form and arranging” · unit summary

rows.translation: Com es construeixen les cançons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · title

rows.translation: Seccions
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: La majoria de cançons tenen unes poques seccions: estrofes que expliquen la història, una tornada que repeteix el motiu i, de vegades, un pont de contrast. Conèixer l’esquema evita que et perdis.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.translation: Què sol portar una tornada?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El motiu que tothom canta
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El solo de guitarra
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: La tornada torna amb les mateixes paraules i melodia. És la part que la gent recorda i canta.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Moltes cançons antigues fan AABA: una melodia, la mateixa altra vegada, un pont de contrast i la melodia de nou. Cada secció sol tenir vuit compassos; aquí en té quatre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: En la forma AABA, quina secció és el pont?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La primera A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La B
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: L’última A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Introduccions i finals
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · title

rows.translation: Aprofita l’última frase
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: La introducció més fàcil és l’última frase de la cançó tocada abans de la primera estrofa. Estableix tonalitat, tempo i caràcter, i qui canta sap exactament on entrar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An intro from the last line
rows.translation: Una intro amb l’última frase
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Why start with the song's last line?
rows.translation: Per què començar amb l’última frase de la cançó?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: És la part més difícil
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Substitueix la tornada
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It sets the key and tempo
rows.translation: Estableix la tonalitat i el tempo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La coda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Per acabar, repeteix l’última frase, sovint dues vegades més, i deixa ressonar l’acord final. La coda indica a tothom que la cançó s’acaba.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Un final amb coda
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Estrofa puntejada, tornada rascada
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · title

rows.translation: Canvia la textura
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Un arranjament fa créixer la tornada canviant què fa la guitarra. Punteja suaument l’estrofa amb els dits i rasca la tornada: els mateixos acords sonen més grans de cop.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Estrofa: Travis amb G i D7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Què fa créixer la tornada aquí?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un canvi de textura
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un tempo més ràpid
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una nova tonalitat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Creix gradualment, no de cop
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Cada secció pot afegir una mica: estrofa puntejada, tornada rascada i tríades més amunt del mànec a l’última tornada. Reserva el so més gran per al final.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Estrofa: Travis amb fluïdesa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Omple les notes llargues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · title

rows.translation: Omple els espais
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
rows.translation: Quan la melodia sosté una nota llarga, la guitarra solista omple l’espai amb una o dues notes greus de l’acord i torna a la melodia a temps.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La frase, senzilla
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: La frase, amb ornaments
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: On van els ornaments?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On top of every melody note
rows.translation: Sobre cada nota de la melodia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: On la melodia sosté una nota
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només a la introducció
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Omple amb notes de l’acord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fill with notes of the chord under the long note. Over G: G, B and D. Over D7: D, F sharp, A and C. They can't clash with the band.
rows.translation: Omple amb notes de l’acord sota la nota llarga. Sobre G: G, B i D. Sobre D7: D, F sostingut, A i C. No poden xocar amb la banda.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Melodia i ornaments
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodia i ornaments, amb fluïdesa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: el teu arranjament
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, un espiritual publicat per primer cop el 1918, rep un arranjament complet: intro amb punteig Travis, dues estrofes amb tornades, un solo pentatònic i una coda.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Intro: Travis amb G i D7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: A solo in G major pentatonic
rows.translation: Un solo en pentatònica de G major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: El solo fa servir la pentatònica de G major en posició oberta: G, A, B, D i E. Segueix els acords de l’estrofa i acaba una pulsació abans perquè hi torni a entrar la veu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: El teu solo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Which parts of this arrangement have no words?
rows.translation: Quines parts d’aquest arranjament no tenen lletra?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Les estrofes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Les tornades
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La introducció i el solo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Espiritual tradicional (publicat el 1918)
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: Cançó: Lluna de màquina de discos
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · title

rows.translation: AABA, estil anys cinquanta
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lluna de màquina de discos és un original de Timbre: un ball lent dels anys cinquanta en forma AABA, una estrofa, l’estrofa de nou, un pont en F i l’estrofa altre cop. Rasca cada temps amb un cop amunt ràpid amb swing abans de cada compàs. La cançó sencera és a Cançons, dins d’Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
rows.translation: A Lluna de màquina de discos, quina secció és la B?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El pont
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La primera estrofa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: L’última estrofa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The verses share one tune: A, A. The bridge brings new chords and a new tune, B, then the verse returns.
rows.translation: Les estrofes comparteixen melodia: A, A. El pont aporta acords i melodia nous, B, i després torna l’estrofa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La primera frase, amb ornaments

rows.translation: Mostra d’arranjaments

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Recolza el cos contra el pit amb el mànec cap a l’esquerra. La corda més propera al terra és la corda 1. Toca la nota a l’aire més aguda.

rows.translation: La més propera al terra

rows.translation: La del centre

rows.source: Strings count up from the floor side: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Les cordes es compten des de la banda del terra: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-1 “Meet your ukulele” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1 with your thumb and let it ring.
rows.translation: Polsa la corda 1 amb el polze i deixa-la ressonar.

rows.source: G C E A, the open strings
rows.translation: G C E A, les cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-2 “G C E A, the open strings” · title

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: De la corda 4 a la corda 1, les cordes a l’aire són G, C, E, A. Prova: Gats Curiosos Exploren Arbres.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-2 “G C E A, the open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.
rows.translation: Toca les cordes 4 i 3, d’una en una.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-2 “G C E A, the open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara les cordes 2 i 1.

rows.translation: Com es diu la corda 3?

rows.translation: La corda de G agut
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · title

rows.translation: La corda 4 trenca el patró
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: En la majoria d’instruments, les cordes es fan més greus mentre puges. A l’ukelele, la corda 4 (G) és més aguda que la corda 3 (C). Això es diu afinació reentrant.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina sona més aguda?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Per què s’afina així
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: El G agut manté les notes de cada acord juntes i brillants. És el so dolç i ressonant que identifiquem amb l’ukelele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Corda 3 i després corda 4. Sents el salt amunt?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Quina corda a l’aire toca la nota més greu?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 4, G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 1, A

rows.translation: Corda 3, C
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Amb l’afinació reentrant, C a la corda 3 és la nota més greu de l’ukelele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Greu, agut, greu, agut

rows.translation: Notes a les cordes 2 i 3

rows.translation: Mateixos dits, noves cordes

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: El trast 2 de la corda 3 és D. El trast 1 de la corda 2 és F. El trast 3 de la corda 2 és G, la mateixa nota que la corda 4 a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-5 “Notes on strings 2 and 3” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 3: a l’aire i després trast 2.

rows.translation: Corda 2: a l’aire, trast 1, trast 3.

rows.translation: És la mateixa nota o és diferent?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-5 “Notes on strings 2 and 3” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2 matches which open string?
rows.translation: El trast 3 de la corda 2 coincideix amb quina corda a l’aire?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-5 “Notes on strings 2 and 3” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Totes dues són G. Dos llocs, una nota.

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Cordes a l’aire, G agut i primeres notes amb trasts. Ves a poc a poc i deixa ressonar cada nota.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
rows.translation: Digues les cordes a l’aire de la 4 a la 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which one is the open G string?
rows.translation: Quina és la corda de G a l’aire?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Les quatre cordes a l’aire, de la 4 a la 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Les notes amb trasts: D, F, B, C.

rows.translation: Popurri de primeres notes

rows.translation: El teu primer acord: C

rows.translation: Un dit, quatre cordes
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: C fa servir el tercer dit al trast 3 de la corda 1. Les altres tres cordes sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rasca amb el polze
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Rasca avall les quatre cordes amb el tou del polze, de la corda 4 a la corda 1. Mantén el canell relaxat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
rows.translation: Amb quin dit toques l’acord de C?

rows.translation: Primer dit

rows.source: Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: El tercer dit arriba al trast 3 sense estirar-se.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat només necessita C. Rasca’l a les dues pulsacions grans de cada compàs i després toca la melodia a les cordes 1 a 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Les cinc notes de la melodia: C i D a la corda 3; E, F i G a la corda 2.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Interludi

rows.translation: Tradicional (1852)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A menor, F, G7 i G: amb C, els acords de moltíssimes cançons.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 “First chords” · unit summary

rows.source: A minor and your first change
rows.translation: A menor i el primer canvi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · title

rows.translation: A menor: un altre cop un dit
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Posa el segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 4 i rasca les quatre cordes. A menor sona més fosc que C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quin acord sona més fosc?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Canvia abans, no tard
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Aixeca el dit que no necessites i col·loca el nou mentre l’últim rascat encara sona. Mira ja l’acord següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: F: dos dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · title

rows.translation: F fa servir dos dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 2; segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 4. Les cordes 3 i 1 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Quin acord comparteix un dit amb F?
