rows.translation: Cap dels dos
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: El segon dit és al trast 2 de la corda 4 en tots dos. Mantén-lo premut quan canviïs.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
rows.translation: G7, l’acord que torna a casa
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · title

rows.translation: G7: un triangle de dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 2; segon al trast 2 de la corda 3; tercer al trast 2 de la corda 1. Rasca totes quatre cordes.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
rows.translation: Un acord que vol tornar a casa
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 sona inacabat. Toca C després i la tensió es desfà. Aquesta atracció fa que tantes cançons posin G7 abans de C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Això acaba a la tònica o et deixa en suspens?

rows.translation: A la tònica
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En suspens
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G: tres dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 2 de la corda 3; segon al trast 2 de la corda 1; tercer al trast 3 de la corda 2. Arqueja els dits perquè soni la corda 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: Quin punt premen tant G com G7?

rows.translation: Trast 1 de la corda 2

rows.translation: Trast 3 de la corda 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Trast 2 de la corda 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Tots dos acords posen un dit al trast 2 de la corda 3. Fes-lo servir d’ancoratge.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Quin és G7, l’acord amb més tensió?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Repte: cinc acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · title

rows.translation: Cinc acords, una mà
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A menor, F, G7 i G serveixen per a centenars de cançons. Forma cada acord amb netedat i mantén la pulsació mentre canvies.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Quin acord fa servir només un dit?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Cops avall regulars, avall-amunt i el rascat illenc.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 “Strumming” · unit summary

rows.translation: Rascats avall regulars
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · title

rows.translation: La mà és un rellotge
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Rasca avall a cada pulsació: 1, 2, 3, 4. Fes servir l’ungla de l’índex. Quan canvies d’acord, la mà continua movent-se.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Què ha de fer la mà mentre canvies d’acord?

rows.translation: Mantenir la pulsació
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Aturar-se i esperar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Accelerar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: És millor un acord tard que una pulsació trencada. Continua rascant encara que una corda trastegi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Compta 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i. Rasca avall als números i amunt a cada i. La mà no deixa de moure’s.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Més suau en el moviment amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Els rascats amunt toquen sobretot les cordes 1 i 2. Frega-les amb el tou del dit, una mica més suau que en baixar.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: On cauen els rascats amunt?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A la i entre pulsacions
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Als temps 1 i 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
rows.translation: Només al final del compàs
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Avall, avall-amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · title

rows.translation: Deixa un buit
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Avall a l’1, avall-amunt al 2, avall al 3, avall-amunt al 4. La mà també puja després de l’1 i del 3, però sense tocar les cordes.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.translation: Què fa la mà a la i de l’1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Puja sense tocar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: S’atura
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Rasca fort amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Un cop amunt silenciós manté la mà a temps per al cop avall següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El rascat illenc
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · title

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Avall a l’1, avall-amunt al 2, omet el cop avall del 3 i després amunt, avall-amunt. El cop omès li dona un balanceig.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Quin rascat omets en el rascat illenc?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El cop avall de l’1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El cop amunt després del 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El cop avall del 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: La mà també baixa al 3, però no toca les cordes. Així el cop amunt següent arriba a temps.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rascat illenc amb canvis
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · title

rows.translation: Canvia a l’últim cop amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: L’últim rascat amunt d’un compàs pot ser relaxat o a l’aire. Aprofita’l per passar a l’acord següent i arribar net al temps 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repte: patrons de rascat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · title

rows.translation: Tres patrons, cinc acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Cops avall, avall-amunt i el rascat illenc. Mantén la mà en moviment i deixa que arribin els acords.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.translation: Quin patró és el rascat illenc?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Toca melodies nota a nota a les cordes 1 a 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · unit summary

rows.translation: Vuit notes, tres cordes
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Comença a la corda 3 a l’aire i puja per les cordes 2 i 1. Totes les notes són als tres primers trasts.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Corda 3 a l’aire i trast 2; després corda 2 a l’aire i trast 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Corda 2, trast 3; després corda 1: a l’aire, trast 2, trast 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Quants noms de nota diferents té l’escala?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: De C a C són vuit notes, però el C agut repeteix el primer. Set noms i després tornen a començar.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Una melodia que ja coneixes
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven va escriure aquesta melodia el 1824. Es mou sobretot per graus conjunts, d’una nota a la següent, a les cordes 2 i 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: L’inici: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria, primera frase
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: La primera frase acaba en D. On acaba la segona?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: En G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En C, la tònica
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un altre cop en D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Mateix inici, final diferent. La segona frase torna a C, la tònica.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria, segona frase
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un salt i després passos avall
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Aquesta melodia tradicional salta de C a G i torna avall nota a nota. Cada frase acaba amb una nota més llarga.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Corda 3 a l’aire, corda 2 al trast 3, corda 1 a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Aquesta frase va amunt o avall?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Frase del mig
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Notes llargues i notes curtes
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · title

rows.translation: Les notes tenen durada
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Una negra dura una pulsació; una blanca, dues; una rodona, quatre. Mantén cadascuna fins que comenci la nota següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Sostén-la
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: El puntet
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Un puntet afegeix la meitat de la durada de la nota. Una blanca amb puntet dura tres pulsacions; una negra amb puntet, una i mitja.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Quantes pulsacions dura una blanca amb puntet?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una cançó d’amor lenta de 1861
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: «Aura Lee» es va publicar el 1861, amb música de George R. Poulton. Toca-la a poc a poc i deixa que cada nota ressoni fins a la següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Una nota nova: F sostingut
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: El trast 2 de la corda 2 és F sostingut, un trast per sobre de F. Un sostingut apuja una nota un trast.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 3, trast 2; després corda 2, trasts 3, 2, 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
rows.translation: Quant apuja una nota el signe de sostingut?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un trast
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dos trasts
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una corda
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: tres melodies
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · title

rows.translation: Escales, passos i salts
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Mira la pista de notes i no perdis el lloc encara que fallis una nota. La pulsació continua, i tu també.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: L’escala de C major, amunt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.translation: On és F sostingut a la corda 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Més acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 “More chords” · title

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D menor, E menor, D, A i E7; després, la cançó de quatre acords.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 “More chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: D menor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · title

rows.translation: Dm: F més un dit
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 4; tercer al trast 2 de la corda 3; primer al trast 1 de la corda 2. La corda 1 sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
rows.translation: A quin acord s’assembla més D menor?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D menor és F amb un dit més al trast 2 de la corda 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Em: una escala de mà
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 2 de la corda 1; segon al trast 3 de la corda 2; tercer al trast 4 de la corda 3. La corda 4 sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Major, brillant
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Menor, fosc
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: Quina corda deixen a l’aire tant E menor com G?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D i A
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · title

rows.translation: D: tres en fila
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Posa els dits 1, 2 i 3 de costat al trast 2 de les cordes 4, 3 i 2. La corda 1 sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: A: dos dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 4; primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 3. Les cordes 2 i 1 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Quin acord té tres dits al mateix trast?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E7 porta a A menor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 4; segon al trast 2 de la corda 3; tercer al trast 2 de la corda 1. La corda 2 sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Un altre acord que atreu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 atreu cap a C. De la mateixa manera, E7 atreu cap a A menor. Toca’ls seguits i escolta com es desfà la tensió.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quatre acords, cançons sense fi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · title

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Numera les notes de l’escala de C i podràs anomenar els acords amb números: C és I, G és V, A menor és vi, F és IV. Aquest ordre apareix en moltíssimes cançons.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: En la tonalitat de C, quin acord és el IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Compta amunt per l’escala des de C: C, D, E, F. F és la quarta nota, així que F és l’acord IV.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Quin acord és el vi en C?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Els números en minúscula indiquen acords menors. La sisena nota de C major és A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: deu acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · title

rows.translation: Ja tens deu acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A menor, F, G, G7, D menor, E menor, D, A i E7. Primer posicions netes; després, rascats regulars.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: En la tonalitat de C, quin acord és el V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cançons
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · title

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Quatre cançons de domini públic amb melodia i acords.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · unit summary

rows.translation: Comptar a dos temps
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster va escriure aquesta cançó el 1848. Es compta a dos temps: 1 i 2 i. La majoria de notes són corxeres ràpides.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: L’inici: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Segona frase
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Una altra cançó de Foster, de 1850. La melodia rebota entre G i E, i una crida curta de dues notes respon a cada frase.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina nota tanca la cançó?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Com la majoria de cançons en C, torna a C, la tònica.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Compta 1 2 3, 1 2 3, amb el pes a l’1. És ritme de vals. «Clementine», publicada per primer cop el 1884, es balanceja a tres temps.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Corda 2, trast 1; 3 a l’aire; 1 a l’aire; després corda 1, trasts 3 i 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: C7: un dit
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 1. Amb F, sosté tota la cançó.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Una cançó lenta de vaquers
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Aquesta melodia tradicional ja s’havia publicat el 1896. Cada frase acaba amb una nota llarga: compta-la sencera abans de la següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: 3 a l’aire; corda 2, trast 1; 1 a l’aire; corda 2, trast 3; corda 1, trasts 1 i 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: L’última frase comença D, C sostingut, C. Com es mouen aquestes notes?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un gran salt amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
rows.translation: Baixen un trast cada vegada
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La mateixa nota tres vegades
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Cada nota és un trast més avall a la corda 3: trast 2, trast 1, a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tradicional (ja publicada el 1896)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: Acompanya una cançó amb acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · title

rows.translation: Acords sota la melodia
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Quan rasques una cançó, la melodia sona al teu cap o a la veu d’una altra persona. Canvia d’acord on la melodia ho demana i mantén el rascat constant.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Una cançó en F sol acabar amb quin acord?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Les cançons tornen a l’acord de la seva tonalitat. En F, és F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: el teu primer repertori
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · title

rows.translation: La teva primera llista de peces
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Quatre cançons, uns quants acords i tres rascats. Toca-les com un petit concert: compta l’entrada, continua i acaba amb força.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noves tonalitats
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · title

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: B bemoll, D7, B menor i G menor; tonalitats de G, F i D; moure una cançó a qualsevol tonalitat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · unit summary

rows.translation: B bemoll: una celleta petita
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · title

rows.translation: Bb: el dit 1 s’estira
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Estira el dit 1 sobre les cordes 2 i 1 al trast 1. El dit 2 va a la corda 3, trast 2; el dit 3, a la corda 4, trast 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Quin acord comparteix amb B bemoll el lloc del dit 1 a la corda 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: F també posa el dit 1 a la corda 2, trast 1. Mantén-lo allà quan canviïs.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.translation: D7 i la tonalitat de G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.translation: D7: una celleta i un dit
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Estira el dit 1 sobre les cordes 4, 3 i 2 al trast 2 i posa el dit 2 a la corda 1, trast 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La tonalitat de G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: En G, els acords G, C i D7 fan gairebé tota la feina, amb E menor per donar un color més fosc. D7 atreu cap a G com G7 atreu cap a C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.translation: B menor i la tonalitat de D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title

rows.translation: Bm: un dit estirat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Estira el dit 1 sobre les cordes 3, 2 i 1 al trast 2 i porta el dit 3 a la corda 4, trast 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: A quines cordes premen el trast 2 tant D com B menor?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cordes 4 i 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només la corda 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cordes 3 i 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Tots dos acords premen el trast 2 de les cordes 3 i 2. Només canvien les cordes exteriors.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La tonalitat de D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: En D, els acords D, G i A7 sostenen la cançó, i B menor hi afegeix tristesa. A7 es fa amb un dit: corda 3, trast 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mateixos números, nova tonalitat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title

rows.translation: Les cançons viatgen amb números
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Els acords d’una cançó són graus de la tonalitat: I, IV i V. Canvia la tonalitat i els números es mantenen. En C són C, F i G7; en G, G, C i D7; en F, F, B bemoll i C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: En la tonalitat de F, quin acord és el IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de F: F, G, A, B bemoll. La quarta nota és B bemoll.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tria la tonalitat per a la veu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Si una cançó és massa aguda o greu per cantar-la, canvia-la de tonalitat. Mateixos números, mateixa cançó, però més adequada a la veu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: En la tonalitat de D, quin acord és el V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de D: D, E, F sostingut, G, A. A és la cinquena nota, així que A7 és l’acord V.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: G menor i tonalitats menors
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title

rows.translation: Gm: tres dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Dit 2 a la corda 3, trast 2; dit 3 a la corda 2, trast 3; dit 1 a la corda 1, trast 1. La corda 4 sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La tonalitat de D menor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: La família de D menor és D menor, G menor i A7. A7 retorna a D menor, com E7 atreu cap a A menor.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repte: noves tonalitats
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title

rows.translation: Quatre tonalitats, una mà
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Res de nou: B bemoll, D7, B menor i G menor, i tonalitats de C, G, F i D. Primer posicions netes; després, rascat constant.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: En la tonalitat de G, quin acord és el V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Estils de rascat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Rascat apagat, rascat illenc amb contracop, swing i acords de ragtime, accents en 3-3-2 i vals.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary

rows.translation: El rascat apagat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title

rows.translation: Un rascat que fa clic
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Un rascat apagat s’atura en sec. Rasca avall i deixa caure el costat del palmell sobre les cordes al mateix moment: un clic curt i sec, com una caixa de bateria.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Avall, apagat, avall-amunt, apagat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Rasca avall a l’1, apaga al 2, avall-amunt al 3, apaga al 4. Els rascats apagats cauen on la bateria toca la caixa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: On cauen els rascats apagats?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Temps 2 i 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Temps 1 i 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només a l’1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: El dos i el quatre són el contracop, on toca la caixa de la bateria. Un rascat apagat allà dona al ritme una empenta de bateria.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rascat illenc amb apagat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.translation: Canvia un cop avall per un apagat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Agafa el rascat illenc, D, DU, UDU, i converteix el cop avall del 2 en un rascat apagat. El ritme és el mateix, però guanya un contracop.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: En aquest rascat, quin cop es torna apagat?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El cop amunt després del 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El cop avall del 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: El temps 1 ressona; el temps 2 fa clic. La resta queda on era al rascat illenc.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Swing i acords de ragtime
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: El swing divideix cada pulsació de manera desigual: llarg avall, curt amunt. Digues taaa-ta, taaa-ta mentre rasques. És el balanceig de les melodies antigues d’ukelele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La progressió de ragtime
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7 i tornada a C. Cada acord de setena atreu cap al següent, una petita cadena de tensió. Va impulsar moltíssimes cançons fa un segle.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Cap a quin acord atreu D7 aquí?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 porta a G i G7 torna a C. Cada acord prepara el següent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Accents en 3-3-2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title

rows.translation: Reforça la i del 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Rasca corxeres avall-amunt constants, però accentua’n tres: 1, la i del 2 i 4. Els accents estan separats per 3, 3 i 2 corxeres.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quines corxeres porten els accents?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 1, la i del 2 i 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Compta 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 sobre les vuit corxeres del compàs. Cada 1 és un accent.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D’on ve
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: El cop dividit de George Formby al banjolele posa els grans rascats als mateixos tres llocs, amb cordes soltes entremig. Domina primer els accents.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rascats de vals
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title

rows.translation: Tres temps, avall-amunt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: A tres temps, rasca avall a l’1 i avall-amunt al 2 i al 3: D, DU, DU. Accentua l’1 perquè es noti el balanceig.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Quants rascats omplen aquest compàs de tres temps?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Avall a l’1; després avall-amunt al 2 i al 3: un més dos més dos.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: estils de rascat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title

rows.translation: Cinc ritmes
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Res de nou: rascats apagats, rascat illenc amb apagat, swing, accents 3-3-2 i vals. Mantén la mà en moviment i deixa parlar els accents.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: En un rascat amb swing, cada pulsació es divideix en…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Punteig amb dits i melodia amb acords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Un dit per corda, patrons circulars, polze alternat i una melodia extreta dels seus acords.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary

rows.translation: Un dit per corda
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title

rows.translation: Un dit per a cada corda
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Recolza el polze a la corda 4, l’índex a la 3, el dit del mig a la 2 i l’anular a la 1. Cadascun polsa només la seva corda.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Polze, índex, dit del mig, anular: cordes 4, 3, 2 i 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Quin dit polsa la corda 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Polze a la 4, índex a la 3, dit del mig a la 2, anular a la 1: un dit per corda.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: C, de la corda 4 a la corda 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un zig-zag, no una escala
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Com que la corda 4 és un G agut, el patró fa zig-zag: agut, greu i després puja. Aquesta lluentor és el so de l’ukelele puntejat amb els dits.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: A menor, F, C, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A menor, F, C, G7, en corxeres
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Patrons circulars
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title

rows.translation: Anada i tornada
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Polsa les cordes 4, 3, 2 i 1 i torna per la 2 i la 3: polze, índex, dit del mig, anular, dit del mig, índex. Sis notes omplen un compàs de tres temps.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: C, anada i tornada
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Després que l’anular polsi la corda 1, quin dit ve?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El dit del mig
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: L’índex
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: El patró fa mitja volta al punt més alt: anular a la corda 1, dit del mig a la 2 i índex a la 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Canvia amb el polze
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Arriba al nou acord quan el polze comenci el compàs següent. Els dits continuen el patró; només canvia la posició de sota.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.translation: C, A menor, D menor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: El polze alternat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title

rows.translation: Polze a cada pulsació
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Ara el polze alterna les cordes 3 i 4 a les pulsacions mentre els altres dits polsen les cordes 2 i 1 entremig. És la versió de l’ukelele del punteig Travis.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: C, afegeix els dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: En aquest patró, què fa el polze?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Toca només al temps 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Alterna les cordes 3 i 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: El polze manté la pulsació, una nota a cada temps, mentre els altres dits omplen els espais.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: G7, el mateix patró
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: C a G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodia dins de l’acord
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.translation: Mantén l’acord, polsa la melodia
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: En la melodia amb acords, la mà del mànec manté l’acord i en polses la melodia. Mantén F: C, F i A ja són sota els dits.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Mantén F: corda 3 a l’aire, corda 2 al trast 1, corda 1 a l’aire. Així comença Amazing Grace.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Afegeix un dit lliure
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Quan la melodia surt de l’acord, arriba-hi amb un dit lliure. Sobre F, el dit 3 toca G a la corda 2, trast 3, i s’aixeca quan la melodia torna.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Amazing Grace, primera meitat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Sobre B bemoll, on és el D de la melodia?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 3, trast 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: El dit 2 de B bemoll ja prem D a la corda 3, trast 2. La melodia travessa l’acord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Amazing Grace, puntejada amb els dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · title

rows.translation: Arranjament complet amb acords i melodia
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Acords arpegiats entre estrofes i melodia dins dels acords. La melodia és l’himne New Britain, publicat el 1829, amb lletra de John Newton.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La introducció puntejada
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Per què l’últim compàs de la intro acaba amb una nota llarga?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Perquè la melodia acaba allà
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
rows.translation: Per deixar espai a l’anacrusi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Per canviar de tonalitat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: L’estrofa comença una pulsació abans, amb l’anacrusi. Una última nota llarga deixa lliure aquella pulsació.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Acords puntejats
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte: punteig amb els dits
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · title

rows.translation: Dits, polze i melodia
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Res de nou: un dit per corda, el patró d’anada i tornada, el polze alternat i la melodia dins de l’acord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Quines cordes toquen polze, índex, dit del mig i anular?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cordes: 1, 2, 3 i 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: De la foguera a l’escenari
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · title

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Quatre cançons de domini públic arranjades per a ukelele i com guiar el públic per cantar-les.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary

rows.translation: Un espiritual per cantar en grup
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, publicada per primer cop el 1918, és feta per cantar plegats. A l’ukelele és en G, amb G, C i D7 i un A sostingut de gòspel a la corda 1, trast 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sostingut, B, després A i G.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Una balada per puntejar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp va publicar aquesta balada anglesa el 1906. En F fa servir F, B bemoll, C i C7, G menor i D menor, sovint dos per compàs. Punteja els acords entre estrofes i deixa’ls ressonar.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: corda 3 a l’aire, F al trast 1 dos cops, G al trast 3 i A a l’aire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Dos acords en un compàs
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Molts compassos canvien a la meitat. Compta l’estrofa en meitats de dues pulsacions, un acord per meitat, i canvia cada dos clics.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Tradicional (Cecil Sharp, 1906)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: Guia el cant en grup
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · title

rows.translation: Compta l’entrada per a tothom
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Abans del primer rascat, compta en veu alta al tempo de la cançó: un, dos, tres, quatre. Tothom comença alhora, a la velocitat que marques.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Continua passi el que passi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Has fallat un acord? Continua rascant i agafa el següent. Quan el públic canta, segueix la pulsació, no cada nota.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Falles un canvi a mitja cançó. Què fas?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Continuar rascant i agafar el nou acord
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Aturar-te i tornar a començar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Alentir fins que ho arreglis
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: La pulsació guia tothom. Omet un acord si cal, però mai el ritme.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Assenyala el final
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Abans de l’última frase, fes un senyal amb el cap o digues última vegada. Alenteix una mica la frase final i deixa ressonar l’últim acord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La cançó de Dublín, a tres temps
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone es va publicar el 1876. És un vals: accentua el temps 1 i deixa que la melodia es balancegi. En F fa servir F, G menor, C7, D menor i G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: corda 3 a l’aire, F al trast 1 quatre cops, A a l’aire i tornada a F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Quin acord atreu més cap a F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G menor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 és l’acord V en F. La seva setena atreu directament cap a la tònica.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tradicional (publicada el 1876; James Yorkston, 1884)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: Sis comptes, dos balanceigs
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Aquesta cançó de rem és en sis per vuit: sis comptes ràpids per compàs, sentits com dos grans balanceigs. Compta 1 2 3, 4 5 6 i accentua l’1 i el 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: En sis per vuit, on cauen les pulsacions grans?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A cada compte
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A l’1, el 3 i el 5
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A l’1 i el 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Sis corxeres s’agrupen en dos grups de tres: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. La primera de cada grup porta el balanceig.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: repertori d’escenari
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · challenge uke-10-6 “Challenge: your stage set” · title

rows.translation: El teu repertori d’escenari
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · challenge uke-10-6 “Challenge: your stage set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Res de nou: quatre cançons amb entrada comptada, ritme constant i final net. Toca-les seguides com un petit concert.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · challenge uke-10-6 “Challenge: your stage set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina cançó comença així?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · challenge uke-10-6 “Challenge: your stage set” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Baix
rows.context: Bass course · title

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: De les cordes a l’aire a línies de baix caminant i ritmes
rows.context: Bass course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hola, baix
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 “Hello, bass” · title

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Coneix E A D G, polsa amb dos dits i toca les primeres notes i una cançó.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 “Hello, bass” · unit summary

rows.translation: Coneix el teu baix
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · title

rows.translation: Quatre cordes, greus i profundes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: La corda més gruixuda és la més greu. Quan toques, és la més propera a la cara. En diem corda 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina és la corda 4?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Les cordes es compten de la més prima (1) a la més gruixuda (4).
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: De gruixuda a prima: E, A, D, G. Coincideixen amb les quatre cordes més greus de la guitarra, una octava més avall. Prova: Els Amics Dibuixen Guitarres.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-2 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polsar amb dos dits
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · title

rows.translation: Índex, dit del mig, índex, dit del mig
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Polsa amb els tous de l’índex i del dit del mig, alternant-los. Recolza el polze a la pastilla o a la corda 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Travessa la corda en polsar
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Polsa travessant la corda, no estirant-la cap amunt. El dit es recolza a la corda més gruixuda següent. Aquesta polsació recolzada sona plena i forta.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Índex i dit del mig sobre E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Where does your finger stop after a rest stroke?
rows.translation: On s’atura el dit després d’una polsació recolzada?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
