rows.source: In the air above the strings
rows.translation: A l’aire damunt de les cordes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al diapasó
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A la corda més gruixuda següent
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Arribar a la corda següent en polsar manté el moviment petit i el so fort.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Recorre les cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Corda 4, trast 3, tercer dit.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-4 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Corda 3, trast 3, tercer dit.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-4 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open E, fret 3, open A, fret 3.
rows.translation: E a l’aire, trast 3, A a l’aire, trast 3.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-4 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Cordes a l’aire, polsació amb dos dits i primeres notes amb trasts. Alterna els dits i deixa ressonar cada nota.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · challenge bass-1-5 “Challenge: first notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which one is the open E string?
rows.translation: Quina és la corda d’E a l’aire?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · challenge bass-1-5 “Challenge: first notes” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ritme de primeres notes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · challenge bass-1-5 “Challenge: first notes” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb necessita tres notes: B al trast 2 de la corda 3, A a l’aire i G al trast 3 de la corda 4. Segon dit per a B, tercer per a G.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · song bass-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Corda 3, trast 2, segon dit. És B.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · song bass-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: corda 3 i després G a la corda 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · song bass-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Fonamentals i precisió rítmica
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 “Roots and timing” · title

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Toca la fonamental de cada acord i encaixa amb la pulsació.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 “Roots and timing” · unit summary

rows.translation: Què és una fonamental
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · title

rows.translation: La fonamental dona nom a l’acord
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: Cada acord es construeix sobre una nota, la fonamental. La fonamental d’un acord d’A és A. Els baixistes toquen fonamentals perquè la banda sàpiga on és la llar harmònica.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.translation: Quina és la fonamental d’un acord de D?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: És la fonamental? Escolta la nota més greu.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Fonamental
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: No és la fonamental
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E: all open strings.
rows.translation: Fonamentals d’A, D i E: totes a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E
rows.translation: Fonamentals d’A, D i E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-1 “What a root is” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Encaixa amb la pulsació
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · title

rows.translation: El millor amic de la bateria
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bass and kick drum land together. Aim for the exact moment of the click, not just near it. Timbre shows if you're early or late.
rows.translation: El baix i el bombo cauen junts. Busca el moment exacte del clic, no només a prop. Timbre mostra si t’avances o t’endarrereixes.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Negres sobre A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You keep landing a little after the click. What helps?
rows.translation: Sempre arribes una mica després del clic. Què ajuda?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Tocar més fluix
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Feel the beat coming and pluck a touch earlier
rows.translation: Anticipar la pulsació i polsar una mica abans
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Accelerar la cançó
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your finger needs a moment to move. Start the pluck slightly earlier so the note speaks right on the beat.
rows.translation: El dit necessita un moment per moure’s. Comença la polsació una mica abans perquè la nota soni just a temps.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Blanques
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-2 “Lock in with the beat” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Silencis i apagat
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · title

rows.translation: Els silencis també compten
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Un silenci és una pulsació sense so. Atura la corda tocant-la suaument amb un dit lliure perquè el silenci sigui tan net com la nota.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Toca, toca, silenci, toca
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How do you stop a ringing string?
rows.translation: Com atures una corda que ressona?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Polsant-la una altra vegada
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Prement-la més fort
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touch it lightly with a free finger
rows.translation: Tocant-la suaument amb un dit lliure
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
rows.translation: Apagar és mitja feina del baixista. Recolza un dit suaument sobre la corda per silenciar-la.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Espai entre notes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-3 “Rests and muting” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Fonamentals des d’un full d’acords
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · title

rows.translation: Segueix el full d’acords
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chord chart tells you which chord is coming. Play its root on every beat until the chart changes.
rows.translation: Un full d’acords indica quin acord ve. Toca’n la fonamental a cada pulsació fins que canviï l’acord del full.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G on string 4 fret 3, C on string 3 fret 3, then open D.
rows.translation: G a la corda 4, trast 3; C a la corda 3, trast 3; després D a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The chart says C. Which note do you play?
rows.translation: El full d’acords diu C. Quina nota toques?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Fonamentals en G
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · lesson bass-2-4 “Roots from a chord chart” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte: fonamentals a temps
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · challenge bass-2-5 “Challenge: roots in time” · title

rows.translation: Fonamentals constants
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · challenge bass-2-5 “Challenge: roots in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roots on the beat, clean rests and changes right on time. Keep your plucking fingers taking turns the whole way.
rows.translation: Fonamentals a la pulsació, silencis nets i canvis puntuals. Alterna els dits que polsen tota l’estona.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · challenge bass-2-5 “Challenge: roots in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is the root of an E chord?
rows.translation: Quina és la fonamental d’un acord d’E?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · challenge bass-2-5 “Challenge: roots in time” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G, C, D amb silencis
rows.context: Bass · Unit 2 · challenge bass-2-5 “Challenge: roots in time” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Les cordes d’E i A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 “The E and A strings” · title

rows.source: Every note from fret 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3, and the major scale shape.
rows.translation: Totes les notes dels trasts 0 a 5 de les cordes 4 i 3, i la posició de l’escala major.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 “The E and A strings” · unit summary

rows.translation: Notes a la corda d’E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · title

rows.source: E to A on one string
rows.translation: D’E a A en una corda
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
rows.translation: A la corda 4, cada trast és una nota més amunt: E, F, F sostingut, G, G sostingut i A al trast 5. El trast 5 sona igual que la corda 3 a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 4: trast 1, trast 3, trast 5.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which fret on string 4 matches open string 3?
rows.translation: Quin trast de la corda 4 coincideix amb la corda 3 a l’aire?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both are A. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Totes dues són A. Cada corda s’afina al trast 5 de la corda més greu adjacent.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Amunt per la corda d’E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Riff a la corda d’E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-1 “Notes on the E string” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Notes a la corda d’A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · title

rows.translation: D’A a D a la corda 3
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 3 works the same way: A, B flat, B, C, C sharp, then D at fret 5. Fret 5 matches open string 2.
rows.translation: La corda 3 funciona igual: A, B bemoll, B, C, C sostingut i D al trast 5. El trast 5 coincideix amb la corda 2 a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 3: trast 2, trast 3, trast 5.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Quina nota és el trast 3 de la corda 3?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Amunt per la corda d’A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Riff a la corda d’A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-2 “Notes on the A string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una nota, dos llocs
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · title

rows.translation: Trast 5 o corda a l’aire
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A on fret 5 of string 4 sounds the same as open string 3. Open strings ring longer; fretted notes are easier to stop and shape.
rows.translation: A al trast 5 de la corda 4 sona igual que la corda 3 a l’aire. Les cordes a l’aire ressonen més; les notes amb trasts són més fàcils d’aturar i modelar.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4, then open string 3.
rows.translation: Trast 5 de la corda 4 i després corda 3 a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 3, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Trast 5 de la corda 3 i després corda 2 a l’aire.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which fret on string 3 matches open string 2?
rows.translation: Quin trast de la corda 3 coincideix amb la corda 2 a l’aire?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both are D. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Totes dues són D. Cada corda s’afina al trast 5 de la corda més greu adjacent.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Queda’t en dues cordes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Amb trast o a l’aire
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-3 “One note, two places” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un dit per trast
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Dona un trast a cada dit: índex al trast 2, dit del mig al 3, anular al 4, petit al 5. El polze es recolza darrere del mànec, davant del dit del mig.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dits 1, 2, 3, 4 als trasts 2 a 5.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Comença en G, trast 3 de la corda 4, amb el dit del mig. Puja per tres cordes: G A B C D E F sostingut G. La mateixa posició funciona des de qualsevol fonamental.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Dit del mig, petit; després índex i dit del mig a la corda 3.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Dit petit; després índex, anular i petit a la corda 2.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?
rows.translation: Mous la posició perquè comenci al trast 5 de la corda 4. Quina escala és ara?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.translation: El trast 5 de la corda 4 és A: la mateixa posició toca A major.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: G major, amunt i avall
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria al baix
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · title

rows.translation: Beethoven, en el registre greu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy works on bass too. Play it in G on strings 4 and 3, with your hand in the scale shape: index on fret 2.
rows.translation: L’Oda a l’alegria també funciona al baix. Toca-la en G a les cordes 4 i 3, amb la mà en la posició de l’escala: índex al trast 2.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 3: trasts 2, 3 i 5.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first line ends on A. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: La primera frase acaba en A. On acaba la segona?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: En G, la tònica
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un altre cop en A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En D
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to G.
rows.translation: Mateix inici, final diferent. La segona frase torna a G, la tònica.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · song bass-3-5 “Ode to Joy on bass” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte: cordes d’E i A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · challenge bass-3-6 “Challenge: E and A strings” · title

rows.source: Name it, find it, play it
rows.translation: Anomena-la, troba-la i toca-la
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · challenge bass-3-6 “Challenge: E and A strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frets 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3 give you every note from E up to D. Say each note's name as you play it.
rows.translation: Els trasts 0 a 5 de les cordes 4 i 3 donen totes les notes d’E a D. Digues el nom de cada nota mentre la toques.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · challenge bass-3-6 “Challenge: E and A strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina nota és el trast 3 de la corda 4?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · challenge bass-3-6 “Challenge: E and A strings” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, A, B, D on strings 4 and 3.
rows.translation: F, A, B, D a les cordes 4 i 3.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · challenge bass-3-6 “Challenge: E and A strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Fonamental, quinta, octava
rows.context: Bass · Unit 4 “Root, fifth, octave” · title

rows.source: Outline chords with the root, its fifth and its octave.

rows.translation: La quinta

rows.translation: Una corda més prima, dos trasts amunt

rows.source: The octave is the same note name, higher. From a root on string 4 or 3, go two strings thinner and two frets up. Open A becomes fret 2 of string 1.
rows.translation: L’octava té el mateix nom de nota, més aguda. Des d’una fonamental a la corda 4 o 3, avança dues cordes cap a les primes i puja dos trasts. A a l’aire passa al trast 2 de la corda 1.

rows.translation: Fonamental, quinta, octava i tornada a la quinta. Sobre A: corda 3 a l’aire, trast 2 de la corda 2, trast 2 de la corda 1. Encaixa amb qualsevol acord major o menor.

rows.source: From G on fret 3 of string 4, use your index finger for the root and your ring finger for the fifth and octave, both on fret 5.
rows.translation: Des de G al trast 3 de la corda 4, fes servir l’índex per a la fonamental i l’anular per a la quinta i l’octava, totes dues al trast 5.

rows.source: Index on the root, ring finger on fret 5 for the fifth and the octave.

rows.translation: Desplaces la posició fins que la fonamental és al trast 3 de la corda 3. Quin acord és ara?

rows.source: Fret 3 of string 3 is C. Same shape, new root.

rows.translation: Fonamental a la pulsació; quinta i octava per omplir el compàs. Mantén forta la fonamental i regulars les altres notes.

rows.translation: Blues de 12 compassos, línies de baix caminant i notes d’aproximació cromàtica.

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: El blues repeteix un bucle de 12 compassos: quatre d’A, dos de D, dos d’A i després E, D, A, E. Compta els compassos i sempre sabràs on ets.

rows.translation: Quants compassos d’A obren el blues de 12 compassos?

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: Els compassos 9 a 12 fan E, D, A, E. L’E del compàs 12 fa tornar al principi del bucle.

rows.translation: Una línia de baix caminant toca una nota nova a cada pulsació. Comença amb fonamental, tercera, quinta, sisena: sobre A són A, C sostingut, E, F sostingut.

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.

rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Deixa de prémer però mantén el dit sobre la corda. La nota s’atura sense trasteig.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Una línia d’estil Motown
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · title

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.translation: Molt moviment, sempre ben encaixat
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Les línies de baix de l’època Motown es movien molt: notes de l’acord, aproximacions al següent i accents fora de la pulsació. Aquesta línia és nova, escrita amb aquell esperit.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Primer compàs: C, E, G i després B bemoll que porta a A.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Compassos 3 i 4
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Què fa B bemoll al final del compàs 1?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Repeteix la fonamental
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Baixa un trast fins a A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Acaba la línia
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: És una nota d’aproximació, un trast per sobre d’A, la fonamental de l’acord següent. Et fa lliscar al compàs següent.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Línia d’estil Motown
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte: repertori de ritmes
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · title

rows.translation: Tres ritmes, un mateix encaix
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Corxeres, ritmes amb puntet i una línia mòbil. Segueix el clic, alterna els dits i gaudeix del ritme.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: En un ritme de corxeres, quins comptes tenen nota?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Només els números
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només els temps 1 i 3
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cada número i cada i
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Violí
rows.context: Violin course · title

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Arc, digitació i afinació: de les cordes a l’aire a les melodies tradicionals
rows.context: Violin course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hola, violí
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Agafa’l, passa-hi l’arc, afina’l, toca les cordes a l’aire i la primera cançó.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary

rows.translation: Coneix el teu violí
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title

rows.translation: Quatre cordes, de greu a agut
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Amb el violí sota la barbeta, les cordes són G, D, A, E d’esquerra a dreta. G és la més gruixuda i greu. E és la més prima i aguda, i en diem corda 1.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: El pont de l’instrument
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: El pont és l’arc prim de fusta que sosté les cordes. Només la pressió de les cordes el manté dret. Si comença a inclinar-se, demana a un professor o a una botiga que el redreci.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina corda és la més aguda?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E és la corda més prima i aguda. Les cordes es compten d’E (1) a G (4).
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Primer polsa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Abans de fer servir l’arc, polsa. Recolza el polze dret al costat del diapasó i estira la corda amb el primer dit. Els músics en diuen pizzicato.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Recolza el violí a la falda com una guitarra petita. Polsa la corda 2, A, i deixa-la ressonar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara la corda 1, E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.translation: Ara la corda més gruixuda, G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Agafa el violí
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title

rows.translation: Clavícula i barbada
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Posa la vora inferior del violí sobre la clavícula esquerra i gira el cap per recolzar la mandíbula a la barbada. El pes del cap el sosté. No l’estrenyis.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: La mà esquerra, lleugera
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Apunta la voluta endavant i a l’esquerra, aproximadament paral·lela al terra. La mà esquerra sosté suaument el mànec, amb el polze davant del primer dit. Mantén el canell recte i relaxat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Què sosté el violí?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.translation: La clavícula i el pes del cap
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La mà esquerra estrenyent fort
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: L’espatlla aixecada
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Deixa reposar el cap a la barbada. Estrènyer la mà o aixecar l’espatlla crea tensió, i la tensió desafina les notes.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Mantén el violí al seu lloc i polsa la corda D, la corda 3.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Polsa al ritme
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Agafa l’arc
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title

rows.translation: Parts de l’arc
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: La vara de fusta va de la nou, on l’agafes, fins a la punta. La crin de cavall s’estira entre totes dues. Estreny el cargol fins que hi càpiga just un llapis entre crin i vara.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Una presa d’arc suau i rodona
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Doblega el polze i posa’n la punta on la nou toca la vara. Deixa caure els dits sobre la vara, amb el dit petit corbat al damunt. Mantén tota la mà relaxada.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: On va el polze?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Doblegat, entre la nou i la vara
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Recte, sota la crin
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.translation: Pla damunt de la vara
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Un polze doblegat a la nou permet relaxar la mà i equilibrar l’arc.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La resina el fa cantar
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: La crin nua llisca sobre la corda sense fer so. Passa la pastilla de resina unes vegades per la crin abans de tocar. N’hi ha prou amb una capa lleugera.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Posa l’arc a la corda A, a mig camí entre el pont i el diapasó. Estira’l lentament cap a la dreta.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Ara la corda D. Aixeca una mica el colze i estira lentament.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Cops d’arc llargs
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: De greu a agut: G, D, A, E. Cada corda és cinc lletres per sobre de l’anterior: un interval anomenat quinta. Prova: Grans Dracs Amaguen Estrelles.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Un nivell per corda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: El colze dret determina quina corda toca l’arc. Aixeca’l per a G i abaixa’l per a E. Cada corda té el seu nivell, com esglaons d’una escala.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Passa l’arc per la corda G i després per D. El colze és més alt a G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Ara A i després E. Abaixa el colze un esglaó per a cadascuna.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.translation: Quina corda necessita el colze més alt?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: La corda G és la més a l’esquerra: aixeca el braç per arribar-hi. E necessita el braç més baix.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Afina el violí
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title

rows.translation: Afina primer A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Les orquestres afinen amb A. Timbre mostra en cents quant s’allunya cada corda de la seva nota; 100 cents fan un semitò, el pas més petit d’un piano. Afina A, després D, G i E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Microafinadors per a petits ajustos
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Els cargols petits del cordal són microafinadors. Gira’n un en sentit horari per apujar el so i en sentit antihorari per abaixar-lo. Amb quarts de volta n’hi ha prou.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Una corda sona una mica baixa. Què fas?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Girar el microafinador en sentit horari
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Girar el microafinador en sentit antihorari
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Empènyer el pont
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Baixa vol dir massa greu. Girar en sentit horari tensa la corda i apuja el so.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Clavilles per a grans ajustos
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Si un microafinador no dona més de si, fes servir la clavilla. Gira-la una mica mentre l’empenys endins perquè s’aguanti. Si la corda està molt desafinada, demana ajuda a un professor: les clavilles poden relliscar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Afina la corda A, passa-hi l’arc i mantén-ne el so estable.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Ara D, G i E. Afina cadascuna, passa-hi l’arc i sostén el so.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Revisió de cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title

rows.translation: Comprova la posició
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Violí a la clavícula, presa d’arc relaxada i arc a mig camí entre pont i diapasó. Ara toca tot el que has fet en aquesta unitat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina és la corda 3?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Passa l’arc per cada corda a l’aire, d’agut a greu. Mantén-ne el so estable.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.translation: Quina corda afines primer?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Les orquestres afinen amb A: comença per aquesta i afina les altres després.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Amunt i avall per l’escala
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb és a la corda A: A a l’aire, primer dit un to amunt per a B i segon dit un altre to amunt per a C sostingut. Polsa-la primer i després fes servir l’arc.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Primer dit a la corda A, un to amunt. És B.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Segon dit un to per sobre del primer. És C sostingut.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: C sostingut, B, A, B i després C sostingut tres cops.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Cop d’arc
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Cops d’arc llargs i regulars, canvis de corda nets i primers ritmes.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary

rows.translation: Arc avall, arc amunt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title

rows.translation: Dues direccions
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: L’arc avall estira l’arc cap a la dreta, de la nou a la punta. L’arc amunt el torna a empènyer a l’esquerra. A la partitura, el signe d’arc avall sembla una tauleta i el d’arc amunt, una V.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: Cap on es mou l’arc avall?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: De la nou cap a la punta
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: De la punta cap a la nou
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cap al pont
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: El punt de contacte
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Toca a mig camí entre el pont i el final del diapasó. Mantén l’arc paral·lel al pont, com un tren a la via.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Un arc avall lent i després un arc amunt lent sobre A. Mantén el so regular fins al final.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tot l’arc sobre A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Tot l’arc a cada corda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Negres i blanques
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title

rows.translation: Negres, mig arc
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Una negra dura una pulsació. Les notes ràpides necessiten menys arc: fes servir la meitat central de l’arc i dona la mateixa llargada a cada cop.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Negres sobre A i D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Blanques, arc més lent
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Una blanca dura dues pulsacions. Fes un cop d’arc més llarg i lent perquè el so no s’apagui a la segona pulsació.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina nota necessita més arc?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una blanca
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una negra
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En necessiten el mateix
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Una blanca dura el doble: li correspon un cop d’arc més llarg i lent.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Curt, curt, llarg
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Canvis de corda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title

rows.translation: Mou des del colze
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Per canviar de corda, canvia de nivell amb el colze, no amb el canell. Arriba al nivell nou just abans que l’arc canviï de direcció.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Deixa que el colze oscil·li entre els dos nivells.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Balanceig entre cordes
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Què mou l’arc a una corda nova?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El colze, canviant de nivell
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Els dits, estrenyent
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Inclinar el violí
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Saltar una corda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Anar de G a A salta la corda D: el colze fa un moviment més gran. Mou-te suaument i no deixis sonar la corda del mig.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Totes quatre, amunt i avall
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Corxeres
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title

rows.translation: Dues notes per pulsació
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Una corxera dura mitja pulsació: n’hi caben dues a cada pulsació. Fes cops d’arc petits i ràpids a prop del centre de l’arc.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ràpid-ràpid, lent
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Quantes corxeres caben en una pulsació?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Llarg, curt-curt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Ara combina’ls: una negra, dues corxeres i dues negres. El violí tradicional es recolza en aquest ritme. Digues-lo primer: llarg, curt-curt, llarg, llarg.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Revisió del cop d’arc
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title

rows.translation: Arc i ritmes
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Arc recte al punt de contacte, canvis de corda guiats pel colze i ritmes constants. Aquí tens una barreja de tots tres.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: On és el punt de contacte?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A mig camí entre pont i diapasó
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.translation: Just damunt del pont
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.translation: Sobre el final del diapasó
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Escalfament de canvis de corda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mitja pulsació
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ritme en cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Primers dits: A i E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Col·loca els dits 1, 2 i 3, toca l’escala d’A major i la primera cançó.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary

rows.translation: Primer dit: B
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title

rows.translation: Sense trasts, només l’orella
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: L’instrument no té trasts: l’orella col·loca cada nota. Molts músics enganxen cintes primes al diapasó per guiar-se mentre aprenen.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Primer dit sobre A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Posa la punta del primer dit a la corda A, a la primera cinta. És B, un to per sobre d’A; un to són dos semitons. Prem fins que la corda toqui el diapasó.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: A a l’aire i B amb el primer dit. Sostén B fins que quedi afinat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Massa agut o greu? Mou el dit
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre accepta una desviació de 30 cents, aproximadament un terç de semitò. Si sona massa agut, mou una mica el dit cap a la voluta. Si sona massa greu, mou-lo cap al pont.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, A a l’aire, B. Aixeca el dit i torna’l a posar al mateix lloc.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: A a l’aire i després B. Quina distància hi ha?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un to
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un semitò
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A i B
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Segon dit: C sostingut
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title

rows.translation: 2 alt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: El segon dit toca C sostingut, un to per sobre de B: deixa espai després del primer dit. En diem 2 alt perquè és a prop d’on anirà el tercer dit.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, C sostingut. Mantén el primer dit premut mentre toca el segon.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: De B a la nota següent: quin tipus de pas és?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: A quina distància per sobre de B és C sostingut?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dos tons
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: De B a C sostingut hi ha dos semitons: el segon dit deixa espai després del primer.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, C sostingut, B, A. Afina cada nota abans de continuar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tercer dit: D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · title

rows.translation: El tercer dit toca el segon
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: El tercer dit toca D, un semitò per sobre de C sostingut: es posa just al costat del segon dit. A la corda A, el patró és 1 i després 2 i 3 junts.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, C sostingut, D. Deixa cada dit premut quan hi afegeixis el següent.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Escolta la ressonància
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Quan D està afinat, la corda D a l’aire vibra amb ell. Comparteixen la lletra, a vuit notes de distància: una octava. Escolta com el violí sona més ple.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D amb el tercer dit, D a l’aire i de nou D amb el tercer dit. Escolta la ressonància.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tenen la mateixa lletra?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sí, a una octava de distància
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: No, són notes diferents
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.translation: Quins dits es toquen a la corda A?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: De B a C sostingut hi ha un to: 1 i 2 deixen espai. De C sostingut a D hi ha un semitò: 2 i 3 es toquen.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Escala de quatre notes
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: La corda E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · title

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: A la corda E, el primer dit toca F sostingut; el segon alt, G sostingut; el tercer, A. És la posició de la corda A, una corda més aguda. Abaixa el braç de l’arc al nivell d’E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, F sostingut, G sostingut, A. La mateixa posició que a la corda A.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: El tercer dit a E toca A. Amb què el pots comparar?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La corda A a l’aire
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La corda G a l’aire
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Amb res; confia en la mà
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: La corda A a l’aire és una octava més greu: ressona quan el teu A està afinat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: L’escala d’A major
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Uneix les meitats: A, B, C sostingut, D a la corda A; E, F sostingut, G sostingut, A a la corda E. Vuit notes d’A a A, una posició tocada dos cops.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Puja lentament per l’escala d’A major. Passa a E per a les quatre notes agudes.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Escala d’A major
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una melodia que coneixes
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Aquesta melodia francesa del segle iniciat el 1700 només usa notes que has après: A, B, C sostingut, D a la corda A, i E i F sostingut a la corda E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Frase inicial
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Quina frase és aquesta?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La frase del mig
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La frase inicial
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Quin dit toca F sostingut a la corda E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Variació 1
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Revisió d’A i E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · title

rows.translation: Dits 1, 2, 3
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: To, to, semitò: és el patró d’A i E. Afina cada nota i deixa que les cordes a l’aire ressonin amb tu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Del segon dit al tercer: quin tipus de pas és?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, C sostingut, D i després D a l’aire. Escolta la ressonància.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Quina nota toca el 2 alt a la corda E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: F sostingut, G sostingut, A a la corda E i després A a l’aire una octava més greu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Escala avall i amunt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Twinkle, una mica més ràpid
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cordes D i G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · title

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: El mateix patró de dits en dues cordes més greus, D major i tres melodies.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · unit summary

rows.translation: La corda D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · title

rows.translation: Mateixa posició, corda més greu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: A la corda D, el primer dit toca E; el segon alt, F sostingut; el tercer, G. És el patró de la corda A, una corda més greu. Aixeca el braç de l’arc un nivell.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, F sostingut, G. El segon i el tercer dit es toquen.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: G ressona amb G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G amb el tercer dit a la corda D és una octava més agut que la corda G a l’aire. Quan està afinat, la corda G ressona amb ell.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G amb el tercer dit, G a l’aire, G amb el tercer dit. Escolta la ressonància.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: A la corda D, quins dits es toquen?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Torna a ser el patró de la corda A: to, to, semitò. El semitò és entre 2 i 3.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Escala a la corda D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: L’escala de D major
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · title

rows.translation: De D a D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Toca D, E, F sostingut, G a la corda D; després A, B, C sostingut, D a la corda A. L’escala de D major és una posició de dits tocada dues vegades.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Puja per l’escala de D major. Passa a la corda A a la cinquena nota.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Amunt o avall?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Va amunt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Va avall
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
rows.translation: Quines notes són sostingudes en D major?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: F i C
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només F
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C i G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D major té dos sostinguts: F sostingut i C sostingut. Tots dos són 2 alt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Escala de D major
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Escala amb llarg, curt-curt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una cançó popular alemanya
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
rows.translation: Lightly Row és una antiga cançó infantil alemanya. Puja i baixa per l’escala de D major a les cordes D i A.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Primera part
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
rows.translation: Quin dit toca els F sostinguts?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 2 alt a la corda D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: First finger on the A string
rows.translation: Primer dit a la corda A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Third finger on the D string
rows.translation: Tercer dit a la corda D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Segona part
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Tradicional
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: La corda G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · title

rows.translation: La corda més greu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: A la corda G, el primer dit toca A; el segon alt, B; el tercer, C. Un altre cop la mateixa posició. Aixeca el braç de l’arc fins al nivell més alt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Mou una mica el colze esquerre sota el violí per arribar-hi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A amb el primer dit a la corda G i després la corda A a l’aire. Mateixa lletra, una octava de distància.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: La meitat d’una escala llarga
