rows.translation: El parell més proper a la cara és el més greu, el parell 4. El més proper al terra és el més agut, el parell 1. Quan una lliçó diu corda 3, es refereix al tercer parell.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.translation: Com toques un parell?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Totes dues alhora, com una sola nota
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només la corda més gruixuda
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una corda i després l’altra
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Les dues cordes estan juntes: un cop de pua les toca totes dues. Juntes ressonen com una nota amb més cos.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Polsa el parell més greu, el parell 4, i deixa’l ressonar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara el parell més agut, el parell 1.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Afina els parells
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · title

rows.translation: Dues cordes, una altura
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Cada parell ha de coincidir amb l’afinador i amb si mateix. Si les dues cordes discrepen, sents una oscil·lació lenta. Afina una corda i porta l’altra a la mateixa nota.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Parell 3, el de D. Afina les dues cordes fins que s’aturi l’oscil·lació.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ara el parell 2, el d’A.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Un parell té una oscil·lació lenta. Què passa?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Les dues cordes no coincideixen
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La pua és massa gruixuda
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Prems massa fort
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Aquesta oscil·lació són batements: les dues cordes tenen una petita diferència d’afinació. Afina-les fins que desaparegui.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Afina pujant fins a la nota
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Afluixa una mica per sota de la nota i després tensa fins a arribar-hi. Aproximar-t’hi des de baix evita que la corda rellisqui i baixi després.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Parell 4 i després parell 1. Porta cada corda fins a la nota des de baix.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Agafa la pua
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · title

rows.translation: Una pinça relaxada
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Agafa la pua entre el tou del polze i el costat de l’índex corbat. Deixa’n sortir només la punta. Mantén el canell relaxat, com si t’espolsessis aigua de la mà.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Quanta pua ha de sobresortir?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La meitat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només la punta
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tanta com sigui possible
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Una punta curta dona control i un so net. Si sobresurt massa pua, s’enganxa a les cordes dobles.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Avall a través del parell
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Empeny la pua avall travessant les dues cordes del parell amb un moviment petit i atura-la just després. Recolza suaument la base de la mà prop del pont.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quatre avall, quatre avall
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Dos cops a cada parell
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: De greu a agut, els parells són G, D, A i E. Prova: Grans Dracs Amaguen Estrelles. El violí s’afina igual: les seves melodies tradicionals encaixen naturalment a la mandolina.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: De greu a agut: G, D, A, E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Com es diu el parell 2?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Quin parell sona més greu?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Ara d’agut a greu: E, A, D, G.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Amunt i tornada avall
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · title

rows.translation: Mostra què saps
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Parells afinats, pua relaxada i quatre notes a l’aire. Toca cadascuna amb netedat, fent sonar totes dues cordes del parell.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.translation: Quin parell és el més agut?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Parell 4, G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Parell 2, A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Parell 1, E
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Els parells es compten del més agut, parell 1, al més greu, parell 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Troba cada parell pel nom.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Passatge en cordes a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb és al parell D: D a l’aire, E al trast 2 amb el primer dit i F sostingut al trast 4 amb el segon.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Parell 3, trast 2, primer dit. És E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Parell 3, trast 4, segon dit. És F sostingut.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Primeres notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · title

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Prem notes amb netedat, aprèn dos trasts per dit i toca l’escala de D major.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · unit summary

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Prem les dues cordes d’un parell amb una punta de dit, just darrere del trast metàl·lic. Les cordes de mandolina són tenses: fes servir la punta i prem només el que cal per a una nota neta.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Parell 3, trast 2, primer dit.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Parell 3, trast 4, segon dit.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: On va la punta del dit?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A mig camí entre dos trasts
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Just darrere del trast cal menys pressió i la nota sona més neta.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: A l’aire, trast 2, trast 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Un dit, dos trasts
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · title

rows.translation: Trasts petits, dits separats
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Els trasts de mandolina estan junts: cada dit en cobreix dos. El primer toca els trasts 1 i 2; el segon, 3 i 4; el tercer, 5 i 6; el petit, 7.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Parell 3, trast 5, tercer dit.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Quin dit toca el trast 4?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Cada dit cobreix dos trasts a la mandolina: el segon s’encarrega dels trasts 3 i 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mateixa posició, parell següent
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: El parell A funciona igual: a l’aire és A; el trast 2 és B; el trast 4, C♯; el trast 5, D. La mà es queda al lloc.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: A l’aire i després primer, segon i tercer dit al parell 2.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Puja i torna
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vuit notes, dos parells
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Uneix les dues posicions i tindràs l’escala de D major: D, E, F♯, G al parell 3; després A, B, C♯, D al parell 2. És la llar de moltes melodies de violí tradicional.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Parell 3: a l’aire, trast 2, trast 4, trast 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Parell 2: a l’aire, trast 2, trast 4, trast 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
rows.translation: Què ve després de G a l’escala de D major?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: B al trast 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A, el segon parell a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G♯ al trast 6
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
rows.translation: Després de G al parell 3 ve A. Toca’l al parell A a l’aire en lloc d’arribar al trast 7.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D major, amunt
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: D major, avall
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una melodia de l’escala
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: La melodia de Beethoven només fa servir les cinc primeres notes de D major, als parells 3 i 2. Mantén els dits suspesos a prop de les cordes entre notes.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ i G al parell 3 i després el parell A a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the second phrase land?
rows.translation: On acaba la segona frase?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: En E
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En D, la tònica
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
rows.translation: La primera frase s’atura en E i sona inacabada. La segona arriba a D i sona com una tornada a casa.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Amunt fins al parell E
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · title

rows.translation: Parell 1, mateixos dits
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
rows.translation: Al parell E, el trast 2 és F♯; el trast 3, G; el trast 5, A. Primer, segon i tercer dit, com abans.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Parell 1: a l’aire, trast 2, trast 3, trast 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: El trast 3 és a la zona del segon dit, els trasts 3 i 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A to A over two pairs
rows.translation: D’A a A en dos parells
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: I torna avall
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de les primeres notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · title

rows.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
rows.translation: Dits primer, segon i tercer als trasts 2, 4 i 5, amb parells a l’aire entremig. Toca amb fluïdesa i deixa sonar cada nota fins a la següent.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Una nota sí, una no de l’escala: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
rows.translation: Necessites C♯ al parell 2. A quin trast?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
rows.translation: Al parell 2, el trast 2 és B, el trast 3 és C i el trast 4 és C♯.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Does the tune go up or down?
rows.translation: La melodia puja o baixa?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: D all the way up to A
rows.translation: De D fins a A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, up to speed
rows.translation: Oda a l’alegria, al tempo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Avall, amunt i trèmolo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · title

rows.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
rows.translation: Alterna la pua en corxeres i fes cantar les notes llargues amb trèmolo.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · unit summary

rows.source: Down on the beat, up between
rows.translation: Avall al temps, amunt entremig
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
rows.translation: Toca amb la pua avall a cada temps i amunt al «i» d’entremig. La mà oscil·la com un pèndol, avall, amunt, avall, amunt, fins i tot quan una nota s’allarga.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Quin cop cau al temps?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Avall al temps i amunt entremig manté la mà a compàs, com les baquetes d’un bateria.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Corxeres en parells a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Avall-amunt, pujant l’escala
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Canviar de parell
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · title

rows.translation: Que el pèndol no s’aturi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: Quan passes a un altre parell, la mà manté el vaivé avall-amunt. L’avantbraç et porta a l’altre parell; el canell manté la pulsació.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Vaivé entre parells
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
rows.translation: Canvies de parell en un «i». Quin cop toca?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El que quedi més a prop
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: A cada «i» toca un cop amunt. Que decideixi el pèndol, no la corda.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D major en corxeres
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Trèmolo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · title

rows.translation: Allarga una nota
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: Una nota de mandolina s’apaga de pressa. El trèmolo la manté viva: mou la pua avall i amunt de pressa i regularment en un parell, perquè la nota soni sense interrupció.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corxeres regulars en A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Semicorxeres en A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Què fa que un trèmolo soni bé?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cops amplis i forts
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només cops avall
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cops petits i regulars
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Mantén la pua a prop de les cordes i fes cops regulars. La velocitat vindrà després, quan el moviment sigui relaxat.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Compta i després deixa’t anar
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Comença comptant quatre cops per pulsació. Quan et sigui més fàcil, deixa de comptar i mantén el moviment ràpid i regular. La pulsació viu al peu, no a la pua.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Trèmolo durant les notes llargues
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Trèmolo en una melodia lenta
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: «Amazing Grace» té tres pulsacions per compàs. Fes trèmolo durant cada nota llarga i canvia de nota just al temps. Hi ha dues notes noves: A i B al parell G.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Parell 4, trast 2 amb el primer dit, després trast 4 amb el segon.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
rows.translation: Com allargues l’A llarg del final?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Toca un cop amb la pua i espera
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Apaga’l de seguida
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: Un sol cop de pua s’apaga molt abans que passin tres pulsacions. El trèmolo manté la nota fins al final del compàs.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de pua
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · title

rows.translation: Mà regular, notes que canten
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Avall al temps, amunt entremig i trèmolo quan calgui allargar una nota. Fes tots els cops petits.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corxeres fins a A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.translation: Quin cop toca el «i» del temps 2?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: A cada «i» toca un cop amunt, sigui on sigui la nota.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Semicorxeres, dues notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Acords i cop apagat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · title

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E menor i A, i l’acord curt i apagat que impulsa el bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · unit summary

rows.translation: G i D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · title

rows.translation: El teu primer acord: G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 2 del parell 2, segon dit al trast 3 del parell 1. Els parells 4 i 3 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: Passa la pua avall pels quatre parells amb un sol moviment fluid, del greu a l’agut. N’hi ha prou amb un gest petit i lleuger; els acords de mandolina són brillants.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: D: dos dits al trast 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 2 del parell 4, segon dit al trast 2 del parell 1. Els parells 3 i 2 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: C i E menor
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · title

rows.translation: C: un petit pas
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 2 del parell 3, segon dit al trast 3 del parell 2. Els parells 4 i 1 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: E menor: un trast enrere
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: Des de C, llisca el segon dit enrere fins al trast 2. L’acord es torna més fosc, tot i que només has mogut un dit.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Menor, més fosc
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A: quatre dits
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · title

rows.translation: A amb tots els dits
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: Trast 2 als parells 4 i 3, trast 4 al parell 2, trast 5 al parell 1: dits primer, segon, tercer i quart. Cap parell no sona a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Per què és important que cap parell no soni a l’aire?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Fa que l’acord soni més fort
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
rows.translation: El pots silenciar afluixant els dits
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the chord in tune
rows.translation: Manté l’acord afinat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: Amb tots els parells premuts, relaxar els dits atura el so de seguida. Aquest és el secret del cop apagat.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El cop apagat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · title

rows.translation: Toca i apaga
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: El cop apagat és un acord curt als temps 2 i 4. Rasca avall i afluixa els dits del mànec sense separar-los de les cordes, perquè el so s’aturi de seguida.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: A quins temps va el cop apagat?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: El baix i la guitarra fan els temps 1 i 3. La mandolina respon al 2 i al 4, com una caixa de bateria.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El so ha de ser curt
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Deixa sonar l’acord només un instant. Si s’allarga, relaxa els dits abans. Les puntes dels dits continuen tocant les cordes tota l’estona.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Cops apagats en G, C i D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · title

rows.translation: Mou la forma d’A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: La forma d’A funciona arreu del mànec. Llisca-la tres trasts amunt per fer C i cinc per fer D. Mantén els quatre dits al seu lloc mentre et mous.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Un cop apagat per a G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G demana una nova obertura: primer dit al trast 2 del parell 2, segon dit al trast 3 del parell 1, tercer dit al trast 5 del parell 3, dit petit al trast 7 del parell 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Acompanyament de bluegrass
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · title

rows.translation: Ritme per al grup
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Rasca acords oberts per aprendre’n el so, després fes cops apagats al 2 i al 4 per donar impuls al grup. Mantén la pulsació regular a cada canvi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: El cop apagat continua sonant. Com ho arregles?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Rasca més fort
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
rows.translation: Separa els dits del mànec
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.translation: Afluixa abans els dits del mànec
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: La mà del mànec apaga el cop. Afluixa la pressió, però mantén les puntes dels dits sobre les cordes.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodies de violí tradicional
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · title

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Cinc melodies tradicionals de sessió, simplificades, de «Boil Them Cabbage Down» a «Old Joe Clark».
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · unit summary

rows.translation: La primera melodia de sessió
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Aquesta viu als parells E i A i torna sovint a F♯. Toca avall al temps i amunt entremig, com als exercicis de corxeres.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G i A al parell 1, trasts 2, 3 i 5, després D al parell 2, trast 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
rows.translation: On reposa la melodia?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A F♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Com la majoria de melodies en D, acaba en D, la tònica.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Cinc notes, una melodia dolça
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: La part greu d’«Angeline the Baker» només fa servir D, E, F♯, A i B. Totes dues parts acaben en A en lloc de D, cosa que convida a tornar a començar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Part greu, primera meitat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Part greu, segona meitat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: En quina nota acaben totes dues parts?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: Acabar en A en lloc de D deixa la melodia en suspens, i així enllaça directament amb la següent volta.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Part greu
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Part aguda
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Un clàssic ben antic
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: «Soldier's Joy» ja s’havia publicat a Escòcia el 1780 i des de llavors omple les sessions americanes. La primera part salta entre D, F♯ i A.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Parell A a l’aire, parell 3 trast 4, D a l’aire i altre cop trast 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: Quin acord formen D, F♯ i A juntes?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ i A són les tres notes de D major. Les melodies de violí tradicional sovint ressegueixen els acords així.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Soldier's Joy, primera part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Part greu, part aguda
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: «Arkansas Traveler» comença greu, al parell G, i salta al parell E per fer una part que baixa per l’escala. Ja s’havia publicat a la dècada de 1840.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Parell 4, trasts 2 i 4, després el parell D a l’aire.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.translation: On comença la part aguda?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Al parell D a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.translation: En A, trast 5 del parell E
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al parell G a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Comença en A al trast 5 del parell 1, i després baixa per G, F♯ i E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Part aguda, primera meitat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.translation: Una tonalitat nova amb un gir
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: «Old Joe Clark» és en A, així que fas servir C♯ i G♯. A la segona part, G♯ baixa a G natural al trast 3 del parell E. Aquesta sola nota li dona el so de la música old-time.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ al parell 3, trast 6; el parell A a l’aire; després G al parell 1, trast 3.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Quina nota dona a la segona part el so de la música old-time?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C en lloc de C♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G en lloc de G♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A, la tònica
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A major fa servir G♯. Baixar-lo a G dona el so mixolidi tan present a la música old-time i al bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de sessió conjunta
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · title

rows.translation: Tria les melodies
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Toca cada melodia sencera a un tempo regular. Si et falla una nota, continua movent la mà de la pua i entra al temps següent. Així funcionen les sessions reals.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Angeline the Baker, part greu
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Quina melodia canvia G♯ per G?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: «Old Joe Clark» és en A, però fa servir G a la segona part. Aquesta nota rebaixada n’és el tret distintiu.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler, part aguda
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lliscaments, lligats i pua creuada
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · title

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Afegeix els gestos de la mà esquerra i el moviment fluid de la dreta que donen a una melodia el so del bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Toca una nota amb la pua i continua prement mentre llisques el mateix dit fins a un trast més alt. La nota nova sona sense cap altre cop de pua. El truc és una pressió lleugera i constant.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Parell 3, del trast 2 al 4
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Què fa sonar la segona nota d’un lliscament?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un segon cop de pua
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Aixecar el dit de pressa
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.translation: El dit que prem mentre es mou
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Només toques la primera nota amb la pua. Mantén la pressió sobre la corda mentre llisques, o la nota s’apagarà pel camí.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Parell 2, del trast 2 al 4
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lliscaments pujant l’escala
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lligats ascendents i descendents
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · title

rows.translation: Lligat ascendent
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Toca un parell a l’aire amb la pua i fes caure la punta d’un dit just darrere del trast 2. La nota nova sona només amb el cop del dit, sense cap altre cop de pua.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: De l’aire al trast 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lligat descendent
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: A la inversa: amb un dit al trast 2, toca amb la pua i estira el dit una mica de costat mentre l’aixeques. Aquest gest polsa la nota a l’aire, més greu.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Del trast 2 a l’aire
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Quins gestos fan sonar una nota sense la pua?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Només els lligats ascendents
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Lligats ascendents, descendents i lliscaments
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només el trèmolo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Tots tres fan sonar una segona nota amb la mà del mànec. La pua només toca la primera.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Lliga amunt, avall i repeteix
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Guarneix una melodia
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · title

rows.translation: Ornaments a Old Joe Clark
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Els petits ornaments donen vida a les melodies de violí tradicional. Aquí, les dues notes A senzilles que obren «Old Joe Clark» es tornen A, B, A: un lligat ascendent i un de descendent.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: A A, B, A, quants cops toques amb la pua?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una vegada
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dues vegades
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tres vegades
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Toca el primer A amb la pua, fes un lligat ascendent fins a B i un de descendent per tornar a A. Un cop de pua, tres notes.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Primera part, amb ornaments
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Old Joe Clark, amb ornaments
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Pua creuada
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · title

rows.translation: Un flux per tres parells
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: La pua creuada toca notes soltes en tres parells amb un patró repetit, perquè l’acord soni com una ondulació. Vuit notes repartides en tres, tres i dues.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ondulació sobre G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Com s’agrupen les vuit notes d’un compàs de pua creuada?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Un patró de tres notes repetit en un compàs de vuit fa que l’accent canviï cada vegada. D’aquí ve la sensació de moviment fluid.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ondulació sobre C
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Ondulació per G, C i D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de mandolina bluegrass
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · title

rows.translation: Tot en una sessió
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Lliscaments, lligats ascendents, cops apagats i pua creuada. Fes cadascun al teu ritme i, sobretot, mantén la pulsació regular.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
rows.translation: A quins temps cau el cop apagat?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Cinc cordes en G obert: patrons, melodies old-time i clawhammer
rows.context: Banjo course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hola, banjo
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · title

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Coneix les cinc cordes, afina en G obert, troba el bordó i toca una cançó.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · unit summary

rows.translation: Coneix el banjo
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · title

rows.translation: Cinc cordes, una de curta
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: El banjo té quatre cordes de llargada completa i una cinquena que comença a mig mànec, amb la seva pròpia clavilla petita. Aquesta corda curta dona al banjo el seu so característic.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Comptar les cordes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: La corda 1 és la prima, més a prop del terra. Les cordes 2, 3 i 4 segueixen cap a la cara. La curta, a dalt, és la corda 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.translation: Quina és la corda curta?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: La cinquena corda és al costat de la corda 4, però comença al cinquè trast, amb la clavilla al lateral del mànec.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Polsa la corda 1, la prima, més a prop del terra.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Ara la corda curta, la corda 5. Polsa-la amb el polze.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Afinació en G obert
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · title

rows.translation: Totes cinc fan G
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: L’afinació estàndard del banjo és G obert. De la corda 4 a la corda 1 és D, G, B, D, i la cinquena corda curta és un G agut. Rascades a l’aire, formen un acord de G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Cordes 4, 3, 2 i 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Corda 5: G agut.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.translation: Quin acord formen les cordes a l’aire?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B i D són les notes d’un acord de G. Per això aquesta afinació es diu G obert.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Polze, índex, dit del mig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · title

rows.translation: Tres pues, tres dits
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: El banjo bluegrass fa servir una pua de polze de plàstic i dues pues metàl·liques de dit, a l’índex i al dit del mig. Les pues de dit apunten avall i es corben com les puntes dels dits.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Qui toca què
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: De moment, el polze toca les cordes 3, 4 i 5, l’índex la corda 2 i el dit del mig la corda 1. Recolza suaument l’anular i el dit petit sobre la membrana.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quin dit toca la corda 2?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dit del mig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Polze
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Índex
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: El polze toca les cordes 3, 4 i 5; l’índex, la corda 2, i el dit del mig, la corda 1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Totes cinc cordes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: El bordó
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · title

rows.translation: Una nota que no canvia mai
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: La cinquena corda és un bordó: la toques a l’aire, entre les notes de la melodia, i sona per damunt de tot. En aquestes lliçons no la prems mai al trast.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Primer la corda 5, després la corda 1. Quina és més aguda?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Per què la cinquena corda sona tan aguda?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: És la corda més gruixuda
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: És curta i afinada en G agut
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sempre es prem al trast
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Ser curta li permet mantenir un G agut. Sona per damunt de la melodia com una campana.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Bordó entre notes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Polze al bordó
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de G obert
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · title

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Afinat en G obert, pues posades i polze a punt per al bordó. Toca cada corda amb un so net i deixa-la sonar.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, G agut, D greu, D agut, G. Troba cada corda per la seva nota.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Quin dit toca la corda 1?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Corda 3, després corda 5. Quina és més aguda?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Passa llista en G obert
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: «Mary Had a Little Lamb» necessita tres notes: corda 2 a l’aire és B, trast 2 de la corda 3 és A i corda 3 a l’aire és G. El segon dit prem l’A; el polze polsa la corda 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · song bjo-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Patrons de punteig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · title

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Els patrons de mà dreta que donen fluïdesa al bluegrass: pinça, polze alternat i patró endavant.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · unit summary

rows.translation: La pinça
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · title

rows.translation: Polze i dit del mig alhora
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Una pinça és polsar alhora amb el polze i el dit del mig, a les cordes 5 i 1. Sona com un petit acord de dues notes i sovint obre o tanca una frase.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.translation: Pinça o una nota cada vegada?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Alhora, una pinça
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una després de l’altra
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
rows.translation: Quines cordes toca una pinça?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Polze a la cinquena corda curta i dit del mig a la corda 1, alhora.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Patró de polze alternat
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · title

rows.translation: Polze, índex, polze, dit del mig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Aquest patró té vuit notes regulars: polze al 3, índex al 2, polze al 5, dit del mig a l’1, després polze al 4, índex al 2, polze al 5, dit del mig a l’1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polze alternat, a poc a poc
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.translation: Quin dit toca una nota sí, una no?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Polze, índex, polze, dit del mig: el polze toca una nota sí, una no, i per això el patró té aquest nom.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Patró endavant
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · title

rows.translation: Polze, índex, dit del mig, i tornem-hi
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: El patró endavant va en un sol sentit: polze, després índex i després dit del mig, una vegada i una altra. Vuit notes fan polze, índex, dit del mig dues vegades, i després polze, índex.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Patró endavant, a poc a poc
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Com encaixa un patró endavant en vuit notes?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Polze, índex, dit del mig dues vegades, i després polze, índex. L’accent es desplaça mentre avances, i això crea el so fluid.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Patrons a compàs
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · title

rows.translation: Pulsació regular amb qualsevol patró
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: Un patró només funciona si va a compàs. Fes les vuit notes regulars, com el tic-tac d’un rellotge, i toca la primera nota de cada compàs just al temps.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Polze alternat a 72
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Patró endavant a 72
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Perds la pulsació a mig patró. Què fas?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
rows.translation: Aturar-te i recomençar el compàs
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow down until it feels right
rows.translation: Alentir fins que et trobis còmode
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Moure la mà dreta i reincorporar-te
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: En un grup, la pulsació no espera mai. Continua el patró i entra al compàs següent.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Canviar de patró
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de patrons
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · title

rows.translation: Patrons de principi a fi
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Pinça, polze alternat i patró endavant, tot amb cordes a l’aire. Mantén les corxeres regulars i deixa sonar cada corda.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Quin patró fa polze, índex, dit del mig, una vegada i una altra?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pinça
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Acords amb patrons
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · title
