rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Prem G, C, D7 i E menor i mantén el patró durant els canvis.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · unit summary

rows.translation: L’acord de C
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · title

rows.translation: C: tres dits
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 2, segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 4, tercer dit al trast 2 de la corda 1. Les cordes 3 i 5 sonen a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Prems la cinquena corda al trast per fer C?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sí, al trast 2
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: No, sona a l’aire
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sí, al trast 5
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: El G agut a l’aire pertany a l’acord de C, així que sona tal com és. En aquestes lliçons no el prems mai al trast.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Patró endavant en C
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Polze alternat en C
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: D7: dos dits
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Primer dit al trast 1 de la corda 2, segon dit al trast 2 de la corda 3. Les cordes 4 i 1 sonen a l’aire. No toquis la cinquena corda: el seu G xoca amb D7.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
rows.translation: D7 complet, si vols
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: El D7 de dos dits no té F sostingut. Afegeix el dit petit al trast 4 de la corda 1 i sonaran les quatre notes de D7. Totes dues formes serveixen per a les cançons; la completa sona més rica.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord wants to move on?
rows.translation: Quin acord demana continuar?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: What does your thumb do on D7?
rows.translation: Què fa el polze en D7?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Toca la corda 5 com sempre
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Prem la corda 5 al trast
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Es queda a les cordes 3 i 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: El G a l’aire de la corda 5 no forma part de D7. De moment, el polze es queda a les cordes 3 i 4.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Polze alternat en D7
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: G, C i D7
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · title

rows.translation: Tres acords, moltes cançons
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G és casa, C se n’allunya i D7 t’hi fa tornar. Canvia al primer temps de cada compàs i mantén la mà dreta en moviment.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
rows.translation: Quin acord et fa tornar a G?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 conté C, que tendeix a baixar fins al B de l’acord de G. Aquesta atracció fa que tantes cançons acabin passant de D7 a G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Patró endavant durant els canvis
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Polze alternat durant els canvis
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: E menor: aixeca un dit
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Fes C i aixeca el primer dit de la corda 2. Dos dits es queden al trast 2, a les cordes 4 i 1, i l’acord es torna més fosc: E menor.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Patró endavant en E menor
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte d’acords
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · title

rows.translation: Prem, punteja i canvia
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Quatre acords i dos patrons. Mantén la mà dreta regular mentre l’esquerra està enfeinada amb els canvis.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
rows.translation: Quina corda no es toca en D7?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Polze alternat: G, C, D7, G
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Patró endavant: G, E menor, C, D7, G
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Quatre melodies tradicionals, amb el bordó sonant entre les notes de la melodia.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 “First melodies” · unit summary

rows.translation: La melodia al davant
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Aquí la melodia és la protagonista: polsa cada nota amb el dit encarregat de la seva corda. Les cordes 3, 2 i 1 fan tota la melodia.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Corda 2 a l’aire, corda 3 trast 2, corda 3 a l’aire, corda 2 trast 1, corda 1 a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
rows.translation: En quina nota acaba la melodia?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Les melodies en G tornen a casa, a G: aquí, la tercera corda a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Part aguda, part greu
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: «Cripple Creek» té una part aguda que fa servir la cinquena corda com a nota de melodia i una part greu a les cordes 3 i 4. Primer toca cada part a poc a poc.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Corda 5 a l’aire, després corda 1 al trast 4 i al trast 2.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: D’on surt el G agut del primer compàs?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La cinquena corda a l’aire
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 3 a l’aire
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Aquí el bordó també fa de nota de melodia. El polze el toca just al temps.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.translation: Una melodia amb nom de coll de muntanya
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap és el coll que els primers colons travessaven per entrar a Kentucky. La melodia puja fins a E i F♯ a la corda 1, així que el segon i el quart dit tenen feina.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: Corda 1: trast 2, trast 4, trast 2 i després a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.translation: On toques F♯ en aquesta melodia?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Corda 2, trast 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 1, trast 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Corda 5, trast 1
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ és quatre trasts per damunt del D a l’aire de la corda 1. Aquí no es prem mai la cinquena corda al trast.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Menor de muntanya
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: «Shady Grove» té el so fosc i antic que els músics anomenen «menor de muntanya». Reposa en A en lloc de G, i el G agut de la cinquena corda hi contrasta.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: Corda 3 trast 2, corda 2 a l’aire, corda 1 a l’aire, corda 1 trast 2.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Què sona més fosc?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Repte de melodies
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · title

rows.translation: Quatre melodies, pulsació regular
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
rows.translation: Quina melodia reposa en A en lloc de G?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
rows.translation: «Shady Grove» és en menor de muntanya, amb A com a centre. Les altres tornen a casa, a G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Cripple Creek, part aguda
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Shady Grove, segona part
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lligats i lliscaments
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · title

rows.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Fes sonar notes amb la mà del mànec i després fes-les servir a «Old Joe Clark».
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Toca una corda a l’aire amb la pua i fes caure la punta d’un dit just darrere del trast 2. La nota nova sona només amb el cop del dit, sense cap altre cop de pua.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Polsa la corda 3 a l’aire i fes un lligat ascendent al trast 2 amb el segon dit.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
rows.translation: Quants cops toques amb la pua per fer un lligat ascendent?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dos, un per nota
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un, per a la primera nota
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cap
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: La pua fa sonar la primera nota. La segona ve del cop del dit sobre la corda.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Lligat ascendent i patró
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Prem una nota, toca-la amb la pua i estira el dit una mica de costat mentre l’aixeques. Aquest gest polsa la corda a l’aire, i sona una segona nota sense la pua.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Polsa la corda 1 al trast 2 i fes un lligat descendent fins a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: Cap on es mou el dit en un lligat descendent?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Recte amunt, separat de la corda
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.translation: Per la corda fins al trast següent
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una mica de costat, polsant la corda
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Aixecar el dit recte amunt només atura la nota. Un petit gest de costat polsa la corda a l’aire.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: El lliscament de bluegrass
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Prem la corda 3 al trast 2, toca-la amb la pua i llisca el mateix dit fins al trast 4 mantenint la pressió. Passar d’A a B en un sol gest fluid és un so clàssic del banjo.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corda 3, del trast 2 al 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Què fa que un lliscament continuï sonant?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pressió constant mentre et mous
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Aixecar el dit al final
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Només toques la primera nota amb la pua. Continua prement mentre llisques, o la nota s’apagarà pel camí.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Entra al patró amb un lliscament
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lliga amunt, avall i llisca
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: L’F de la música old-time
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: «Old Joe Clark» és en G, però la segona part fa servir F en lloc de F♯, a la corda 1, trast 3. Aquesta nota rebaixada li dona el so de la música old-time.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: Corda 1: trast 2, trast 3, trast 2, a l’aire. Prova un lligat ascendent del 2 al 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Quina nota dona a la segona part el color de la música old-time?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: F en lloc de F♯
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G, la tònica
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G major fa servir F♯. Baixar-lo a F dona el so mixolidi tan present a la música old-time i al bluegrass.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de mà esquerra
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · title

rows.translation: Mà esquerra, et presento la dreta
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Lligats ascendents, descendents i lliscaments, i després «Old Joe Clark». Toca amb la pua només on calgui i deixa la resta a la mà del mànec.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Quin gest fa lliscar una nota premuda fins a un trast més alt?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un lligat ascendent
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un lligat descendent
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un lliscament
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: Una mà dreta diferent: colpeja avall amb una ungla i enganxa el bordó amb el polze.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 “Clawhammer” · unit summary

rows.translation: Una mà dreta nova
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · title

rows.translation: Forma d’urpa
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: El clawhammer no fa servir pues. Corba la mà en una urpa relaxada i colpeja una corda cap avall amb el dors de l’ungla de l’índex o del dit del mig, movent el canell i l’avantbraç.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: El polze enganxa la corda 5
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: Quan la mà colpeja, el polze es recolza a la cinquena corda. Al temps següent, l’empeny i la deixa anar mentre aixeques la mà.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: Cap on es mou l’ungla en el clawhammer?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Amunt, com una pua de dit
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Avall, cap al terra
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: D’un costat a l’altre
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: El clawhammer colpeja avall amb l’ungla. Els dits no polsen mai cap amunt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Cop i després polze
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Avall per les cordes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Bum-diti
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · title

rows.translation: Bum, di, ti
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: El ritme bàsic del clawhammer sona com el seu nom. Bum: colpeja una nota al temps. Di: rasca avall les cordes. Ti: el polze toca la corda 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.translation: Quina part del bum-diti toca el polze?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Bum, la primera
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Di, la del mig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ti, l’última
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum és una nota sola, di és un rascat i ti és el polze a la cinquena corda.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Bum, rascat, polze
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: La melodia al bum
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · title

rows.translation: La melodia va amb el bum
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: En el clawhammer, les notes de la melodia cauen als cops bum. El rascat i el polze omplen els espais, i així melodia i ritme sonen junts.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Bum-diti en C
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.translation: On van les notes de la melodia en el bum-diti?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Al ti, el polze
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al bum, el cop
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Al di, el rascat
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.translation: El bum cau al temps, i per això és on va la melodia. Di i ti mantenen el ritme en marxa.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Una melodia en bum-diti
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Una melodia de joc de festa
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.translation: «Skip to My Lou» era un joc de festa a la dècada de 1840. En el clawhammer, cada nota de la melodia és un bum, seguit d’un rascat i del polze a la corda 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Només la melodia
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.translation: Què toca el polze després de cada rascat?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La nota de la melodia
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Res; descansa
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum, di, ti: el ti sempre és el polze a la cinquena corda curta.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Primera meitat, clawhammer
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Repte de clawhammer
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · title

rows.translation: Cop, rascat, polze
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.translation: Tot en el clawhammer torna al bum-diti. Mantén el moviment relaxat i el polze a punt, i la melodia sortirà sola.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.translation: Quina forma de mà fa servir el clawhammer?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dits que polsen amunt amb pues
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una pua plana
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una urpa relaxada que colpeja avall
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Entrenament auditiu
rows.context: Ear Training course · title

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Reconeix intervals i acords i canta el que sents
rows.context: Ear Training course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Més agut o més greu
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · title

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Distingeix quina de dues notes és més aguda, des de salts amples fins al pas més petit.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary

rows.translation: Agut i greu
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: L’altura és com d’aguda o greu sona una nota. En un teclat, les notes greus són a l’esquerra i les agudes a la dreta. L’oïda ja sap distingir-les; aquí l’afinaràs.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Amunt o avall
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Quan la segona nota és més aguda, la melodia puja. Quan és més greu, baixa. Dibuixa la direcció a l’aire amb la mà mentre escoltes.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: La segona nota puja o baixa?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Salts més petits
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title

rows.translation: Més a prop
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Com més a prop són dues notes, més costa distingir-les. Deixa acabar cada nota abans de respondre. Cada resposta, encertada o no, entrena l’oïda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Taral·leja la distància
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Tens dubtes? Taral·leja la primera nota i llisca amb la veu fins a la segona. Nota si la veu puja o baixa. El cos sap la direcció.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Notes veïnes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Moltes melodies passen a la nota següent de l’escala: un petit pas. Els passos sonen fluids i propers. Escolta si hi ha una pujada o baixada suau en lloc d’un salt.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Conserva la primera nota
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Mantén la primera nota al cap mentre sona la segona. Després compara-les, com si miressis dues altures l’una al costat de l’altra.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: El pas més petit
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title

rows.translation: El semitò
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: El pas més petit en la majoria de música és el semitò: d’una tecla a la immediatament següent. És un moviment diminut que pots aprendre a sentir.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Confia en la primera impressió
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Amb passos molt petits, la primera impressió sol ser l’encertada. Respon i no et facis enrere.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Repte d’aguts i greus
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title

rows.translation: Totes les distàncies i tots els registres
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Salts amples, passos petits i semitons, aguts i greus, tot barrejat. Respira abans de cadascun.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Igual o diferent
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Reconeix quan dues notes són iguals i després imita una nota amb la veu o l’instrument.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary

rows.translation: Igual o diferent?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Dues notes són iguals quan tenen exactament la mateixa altura. Escolta si la segona cau just sobre la primera o se n’aparta.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Dues veus canten exactament a la mateixa altura. Com es diu?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un acord
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uníson
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una octava
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Cantar a l’uníson vol dir cantar exactament la mateixa nota.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Imita una nota
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title

rows.translation: Canta el que sents
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Per imitar una altura, escolta, torna a sentir la nota al cap i després canta-la o toca-la. Timbre mostra si vas massa amunt o avall. Llisca fins a trobar-la.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Canta o toca la nota que acabes de sentir.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Canta o toca la segona nota que has sentit.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Llisca fins a afinar
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Si no l’encertes, no t’aturis. Llisca a poc a poc amunt o avall fins a afinar la nota. Així l’oïda i la veu aprenen a posar-se d’acord.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mantén-la al cap
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title

rows.translation: Audició interior
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Abans de cantar, torna a sentir la nota en silenci al cap. Els músics en diuen audiation: sentir música que no està sonant. És la base d’una bona oïda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.translation: Canta o toca la nota més aguda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.translation: Canta o toca la nota més greu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repeteix dues notes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title

rows.translation: Dues seguides
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Ara imita dues notes seguides. Canta la primera i passa a la segona. Fixa’t si la veu puja o baixa per arribar-hi.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Canta o toca, en ordre, les notes que acabes de sentir.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte d’imitar altures
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title

rows.translation: Escolta i després imita
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Igual o diferent, notes soles i parelles. Escolta fins al final abans de cantar i llisca fins que cada nota quedi afinada.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Passos i salts
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · title

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Reconeix semitons i tons i després el salt més ample d’una tercera.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary

rows.translation: Semitons i tons
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title

rows.translation: Semitons i tons sencers
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Un semitò va a la tecla següent. Un to se’n salta una, així que equival a dos semitons. Tots dos sonen com passos, però un to obre una mica més la distància.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Semitò o to?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Semitò
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: To
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.translation: Quants semitons formen un to?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Un to se salta una tecla, així que són dos semitons.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Segones
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · title

rows.translation: Els passos són segones
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Els músics anomenen segona un pas, perquè va a la lletra següent: de C a D. Un semitò és una segona menor. Un to és una segona major.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quin interval sents?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Segona menor
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Segona major
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: E up to F is a...
rows.translation: D’E cap amunt fins a F és una...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Tercera
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: Entre E i F no hi ha cap tecla: un semitò i, per tant, una segona menor.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.translation: De C cap amunt fins a D és una...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: De C a D se salta la tecla negra d’entremig: un to i, per tant, una segona major.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Un pas va a la lletra següent. Un salt se’n salta una, com de C a E, deixant D entremig. Aquesta distància es diu tercera. Els salts sonen més oberts que els passos.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Pas o salt?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pas
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Salt
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: D up to F is a...
rows.translation: De D cap amunt fins a F és...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: De D a F se salta E, així que és un salt: una tercera.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Terceres majors i menors
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · title

rows.translation: Dues mides de tercera
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.translation: Una tercera major abasta quatre semitons i sona lluminosa. Una tercera menor n’abasta tres i sona més fosca, una mica melangiosa. Escolta’n la lluminositat.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Tercera menor
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tercera major
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: Quants semitons hi ha de C cap amunt fins a E?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: quatre semitons i, per tant, una tercera major.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de passos i salts
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · title

rows.translation: Passos, salts i distàncies
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Semitons, tons i terceres, pujant i baixant. Primer decideix si és un pas o un salt, i després la distància exacta.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Uníson, octava, quinta i quarta, cadascun lligat a una melodia que pots taral·lejar.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary

rows.translation: Uníson i octava
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Un interval és la distància entre dues notes. Un uníson no té cap distància: la mateixa nota dos cops. Una octava va d’una lletra a la mateixa lletra més amunt, com de C a C. Sona com una sola nota, però més brillant.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Melodies per recordar
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: «Jingle Bells» comença repetint una nota: un uníson. «Take Me Out to the Ball Game» comença amb un salt d’octava amunt. Taral·leja cada inici per recordar-ne el so.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Octava
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
rows.translation: Per què es diu octava?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Abasta vuit noms de lletra
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Té vuit sostinguts
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dura vuit pulsacions
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: vuit noms de lletra, comptant tots dos extrems.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La quinta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Una quinta justa abasta set semitons, com de C amunt fins a G. Sona oberta i forta. «Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star» salta una quinta amunt després de les dues primeres notes.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quinta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Quina nota és una quinta justa per damunt de D?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Compta cinc lletres: D, E, F, G, A. De D a A hi ha set semitons.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La quarta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Una quarta justa abasta cinc semitons, com de C amunt fins a F. Sona com una crida d’atenció. «Amazing Grace» comença amb una quarta ascendent.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quarta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quarta o quinta?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Totes dues sonen obertes. La quinta és més ampla i sembla estable. La quarta sembla que vulgui continuar. Si tens dubtes, taral·leja la melodia de cadascuna.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina és més ampla?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una quarta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una quinta justa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Una quinta abasta set semitons; una quarta, cinc.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Baixant i alhora
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · title

rows.translation: Els intervals van en tots dos sentits
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Un interval manté el nom tant si puja com si baixa. De G avall fins a C continua sent una quinta. Escolta la distància, no la direcció.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Quan dues notes sonen alhora, escolta com es barregen. Una octava es fon en un sol so. Una quinta sona buida i forta. Una quarta sona oberta però inquieta.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Canta o toca una quinta descendent: de G avall fins a C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte d’intervals I
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · title

rows.translation: Quatre intervals de totes les maneres
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Uníson, octava, quinta i quarta, pujant, baixant i alhora. Si t’encalles, taral·leja la melodia de cadascun.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Terceres, sisenes i segones, en les seves versions major i menor.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · unit summary

rows.translation: Terceres que coneixes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · title

rows.translation: Terceres amb una melodia
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: «When the Saints Go Marching In» comença amb una tercera major, lluminosa i atrevida. «Greensleeves» comença amb una tercera menor, més suau i trista. Taral·leja totes dues per fixar-ne el so.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.translation: Quants semitons té una tercera menor?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Una tercera menor abasta tres semitons, com d’A a C. Una tercera major n’abasta quatre.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Sisenes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · title

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Una sisena major abasta nou semitons; «My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean» comença amb una. Una sisena menor n’abasta vuit i sona més fosca. «The Entertainer» en salta una amunt just després de les notes ràpides inicials.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Sisena menor
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sisena major
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: Quin interval hi ha de C cap amunt fins a A?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: De C a A hi ha nou semitons: una sisena major.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Segones que coneixes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · title

rows.translation: Segones amb una melodia
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: «Frère Jacques» comença amb una segona major, un to amunt. «Per a Elisa» comença baixant i pujant una segona menor, un semitò. Distàncies petites, gran diferència.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.translation: Quin interval és un semitò?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Una segona menor és un semitò. Una segona major en són dos.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Canta o toca el vaivé de semitò: E, D♯, E.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Barrejar distàncies
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · title

rows.translation: Redueix les opcions
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Primer valora la distància: un pas, un salt o un salt ample. Després valora el color: lluminós si és major, més fosc si és menor. Dues decisions fàcils valen més que una conjectura difícil.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Una sisena major
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Una sisena menor
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Els intervals menors sonen més foscos que els seus equivalents majors.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte d’intervals II
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · title

rows.translation: Totes les distàncies fins ara
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Segones, terceres i sisenes, majors i menors, barrejades amb les quartes i quintes que ja coneixes.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Tipus d’acord
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · title

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Reconeix acords majors i menors, després disminuïts, augmentats i de setena de dominant.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · unit summary

rows.translation: Colors dels acords
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Un acord són tres notes o més que sonen alhora. Un acord major sona lluminós i estable. Un acord menor sona més fosc. Només la nota del mig és diferent.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Un acord major es torna menor. Quantes notes canvien?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Totes tres
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Només la nota del mig, la tercera, baixa un semitò: C E G es torna C E♭ G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Canta o toca les notes de l’acord, de greu a agut.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Major i menor arreu
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · title

rows.translation: Escolta el mig
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Tens dubtes? Centra’t en la nota del mig. En un acord major és quatre semitons per damunt de la nota greu. En un de menor és un semitò més avall, i això ho enfosqueix tot.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.translation: Quines notes formen un acord de C menor?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Baixa un semitò la nota del mig de C major: E es torna E♭.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Disminuït i augmentat
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · title

rows.translation: Acords tensos
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Un acord disminuït apila dues terceres menors i sona comprimit i inquiet. Un acord augmentat apila dues terceres majors i sona estirat, com una pregunta en suspens.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.translation: De quin tipus és aquest acord?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Disminuït
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Augmentat
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Quin acord apila dues terceres majors?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Una tercera major més una tercera major, com C E G♯, forma un acord augmentat.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: La setena de dominant
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · title

rows.translation: Afegeix una setena
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Un acord de setena de dominant és un acord major amb una nota més al damunt: una setena menor per sobre de la fonamental, la nota que dona nom a l’acord. Sona a blues i inquiet.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Setena de dominant
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quines notes formen G7?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 és G major (G B D) més F, una setena menor per damunt de G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de tipus d’acord
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · title

rows.translation: Cinc colors
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
rows.translation: Major, menor, disminuït, augmentat i setena de dominant: lluminós, fosc, comprimit, estirat, inquiet. Digues el color i després l’acord.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Graus de l’escala
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · title

rows.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
rows.translation: Reconeix el lloc de cada nota en una tonalitat, des de do, la tònica, fins a ti.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · unit summary

rows.translation: Do, la tònica
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · title

rows.translation: La base de casa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
rows.translation: Cada tonalitat té una nota de repòs, anomenada tònica. Els cantants l’anomenen do. Aquí sentiràs un acord que estableix la tonalitat i després una nota que hauràs de situar.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
rows.translation: L’última nota és do, la tònica?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sí
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
rows.translation: Les notes d’una escala major són do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti i altre cop do. Cadascuna és un grau de l’escala, numerat des de do: do és 1, re és 2, fins a ti, 7.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
rows.translation: Quin grau de l’escala és l’última nota?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
rows.translation: Canta o toca do, re, mi en C major: C, D, E.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Do, mi i sol
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · title

rows.translation: Les notes de l’acord
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
rows.translation: Do, mi i sol són les notes de l’acord de tònica, així que sonen estables i en repòs. Mi sona dolç, sol sona fort i obert, i do sona conclusiu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which note is sol?
rows.translation: En C major, quina nota és sol?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Canta o toca do, mi, sol en G major: G, B, D.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Notes que busquen repòs
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · title

rows.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
rows.translation: Re, fa, la i ti sonen inconclusos. Ti és un semitò per sota de do i hi tendeix amb força. Fa tendeix a baixar a mi. Re i la volen fer un pas fins a una nota veïna.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
rows.translation: Quina nota tendeix amb més força a pujar fins a do?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
rows.translation: Ti és només un semitò per sota de do, així que hi tendeix amb força.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
rows.translation: Canta o toca ti pujant fins a do en C major: B i després C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tots set, després d’una cadència
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · title

rows.source: Set the key with a cadence
rows.translation: Estableix el to amb una cadència
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
rows.translation: Una cadència és un patró curt d’acords que tanca una frase. Sentir-ne una estableix bé la tonalitat. Canta do fluixet per a tu i mesura la nota nova a partir d’aquí.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
rows.translation: Per què es toca una cadència abans de la nota?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Per establir la tonalitat
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Per establir el tempo
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Per escalfar la veu
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
