rows.translation: Els acords assenyalen do, i així pots sentir qualsevol altra nota en relació amb ell.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.translation: Canta o toca pujant l’escala des de do en C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte de graus de l’escala
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · title

rows.translation: Troba do i després la nota
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
rows.translation: Els acords estableixen la tonalitat i després sona una nota. Troba primer do i després digues quina nota és. Totes les tonalitats funcionen igual.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.translation: Canta o toca do, ti, do en D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Dictat melòdic
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · title

rows.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
rows.translation: Escolta melodies curtes, tria la que has sentit i canta-la.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · unit summary

rows.translation: Melodies de tres notes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · title

rows.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
rows.translation: Fer un dictat vol dir escoltar una melodia i escriure-la. Aquí la tries d’una llista. Troba do a partir de l’acord i segueix cada moviment: amunt o avall, pas o salt.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina melodia has sentit?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dibuixa la forma
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
rows.translation: Abans de dir les notes, dibuixa la forma amb la mà: amunt, avall o canviant de direcció. La majoria de respostes incorrectes tenen una forma diferent, i les pots descartar de pressa.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Salts en una melodia
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · title

rows.translation: Els salts destaquen
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
rows.translation: Els passos sonen fluids; els salts destaquen. Quan sentis un salt, comprova si arriba a una nota de l’acord de tònica: do, mi o sol.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A melody goes do, mi, sol. How does it move?
rows.translation: Una melodia fa do, mi, sol. Com es mou?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dos salts amunt
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dos passos amunt
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un pas i després un salt
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do to mi skips re, and mi to sol skips fa.
rows.translation: De do a mi se salta re, i de mi a sol se salta fa.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodies de quatre notes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · title

rows.translation: Quatre notes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
rows.translation: Les melodies més llargues fan servir les mateixes eines. Fixa la primera nota respecte de do i segueix la resta d’un moviment en un.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A melody stops on ti. How does it sound?
rows.translation: Una melodia s’atura en ti. Com sona?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Inconclusa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Conclosa
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Desafinada
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
rows.translation: Ti tendeix a pujar a do, així que una melodia que s’atura en ti sembla que esperi.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Per sota de do
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · title

rows.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
rows.translation: Les melodies sovint baixen per sota de do fins a ti, la o sol. Són les mateixes notes, però més greus. Moltes melodies comencen al sol de sota i salten amunt fins a do.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
rows.translation: «Amazing Grace» comença en sol per sota de do i salta amunt. Fins a quina nota?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
rows.translation: De sol amunt fins a do és una quarta justa, l’interval que vas aprendre amb aquesta melodia.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de dictat
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · title

rows.source: Hear it, find it, sing it
rows.translation: Escolta-la, troba-la i canta-la
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Chords first, then the melody. Find do, trace the shape, name each note, then sing or play it back.
rows.translation: Primer els acords i després la melodia. Troba do, dibuixa la forma, digues cada nota i després canta-la o toca-la.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Teoria musical
rows.context: Music Theory course · title

rows.source: How music works, from note names to the chords behind songs
rows.translation: Com funciona la música, dels noms de les notes als acords de les cançons
rows.context: Music Theory course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Notes i alfabet
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 “Notes and the alphabet” · title

rows.source: Seven letters, repeating octaves, and where every note lives on a keyboard.
rows.translation: Set lletres, octaves que es repeteixen i el lloc de cada nota en un teclat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 “Notes and the alphabet” · unit summary

rows.translation: L’alfabet musical
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · title

rows.translation: Set lletres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
rows.translation: La música anomena les notes amb només set lletres: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. Després de G, l’alfabet torna a començar a A, una mica més amunt a cada volta.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Què ve després de G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The musical alphabet stops at G and starts again at A.
rows.translation: L’alfabet musical s’acaba a G i torna a començar a A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which letter comes just before C?
rows.translation: Quina lletra va just abans de C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Going down, the alphabet runs C, B, A, then G.
rows.translation: Baixant, l’alfabet fa C, B, A i després G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Amunt i avall per l’alfabet
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
rows.translation: Si avances per les lletres, d’A a B i a C, les notes pugen. Si vas enrere, baixen. Les lletres fan la volta com les hores d’un rellotge.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What are the next two letters after F?
rows.translation: Quines dues lletres van després de F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, then back around to A.
rows.translation: F, G i després tornem a A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quina llista baixa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
rows.translation: Anar enrere per l’alfabet vol dir notes més greus: E, D, C, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
rows.translation: Toca o canta C, D, E, pujant per l’alfabet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: La mateixa lletra, més amunt
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
rows.translation: Les notes amb la mateixa lletra s’assemblen encara que una sigui més aguda. La distància d’un C al C següent és una octava. La nota més aguda vibra exactament el doble de ràpid.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
rows.translation: Aquestes dues notes tenen el mateix nom de lletra?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
rows.translation: A4 vibra 440 vegades per segon. A quina velocitat vibra A5?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 220 vegades
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 450 vegades
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 880 vegades
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
rows.translation: Una octava amunt duplica la vibració: 440 es torna 880.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Números d’octava
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
rows.translation: Les notes porten un número que indica a quina octava són. El C central, prop del centre del piano, és C4. El número augmenta en un a cada C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note is just above B3?
rows.translation: Quina nota hi ha just per damunt de B3?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
rows.translation: Els números d’octava canvien a C, així que la nota següent per damunt de B3 és C4.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
rows.translation: Toca o canta el C central i després el C una octava més amunt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: El mapa del teclat
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · title

rows.translation: De dues i de tres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
rows.translation: Les tecles negres d’un teclat formen grups de dues i de tres. Són el teu mapa. C és la tecla blanca just a l’esquerra de cada grup de dues.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quina nota està ressaltada?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: C és just a l’esquerra del grup de dues tecles negres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F and the group of three
rows.translation: F i el grup de tres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
rows.translation: F és la tecla blanca just a l’esquerra de cada grup de tres tecles negres. Troba primer C i F, i només hauràs de comptar una mica per trobar qualsevol altra tecla blanca.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: F és just a l’esquerra del grup de tres tecles negres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
rows.translation: D és entre les dues tecles negres del parell.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: B és la tecla blanca just a la dreta del grup de tres tecles negres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
rows.translation: Toca o canta F, G, A, començant per l’F que acabes de trobar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Totes les tecles blanques
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · title

rows.translation: Compta des de C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
rows.translation: Des de C, les tecles blanques fan C, D, E, F, G, A, B i altre cop C. Set tecles blanques tenen una de cada lletra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: G és entre les dues primeres tecles negres del grup de tres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: E és la tecla blanca just a la dreta del grup de dues tecles negres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: A és entre les dues últimes tecles negres del grup de tres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
rows.translation: Quantes tecles blanques hi ha d’un C fins al B següent més amunt?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: set lletres, set tecles blanques.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
rows.translation: Toca o canta pujant les tecles blanques del C central fins al C següent.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte de notes i lletres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · title

rows.translation: Lletres, octaves i tecles
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
rows.translation: L’alfabet, les octaves i el mapa del teclat, tot junt. Fes servir els grups de tecles negres per orientar-te.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which two letters come right after E?
rows.translation: Quines dues lletres van just després d’E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
rows.translation: E, F, G: endavant per l’alfabet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
rows.translation: El C central és C4. Quin és el C una octava més amunt?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
rows.translation: Cada octava amunt suma un al número.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
rows.translation: Toca o canta G, A, B, C. L’alfabet fa la volta de G a A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sostinguts, bemolls i semitons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 “Sharps, flats and half steps” · title

rows.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
rows.translation: Les tecles negres, el pas més petit i les notes amb dos noms.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 “Sharps, flats and half steps” · unit summary

rows.translation: Semitons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · title

rows.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
rows.translation: Un semitò va d’una tecla a la següent, negra o blanca, sense res entremig. És la distància més petita en un teclat i en la majoria de música.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a half step above E?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un semitò per damunt d’E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E and F have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Entre E i F no hi ha cap tecla negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Dos semitons entre tecles blanques
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
rows.translation: Busca els espais sense tecla negra: d’E a F i de B a C. Aquestes tecles blanques són l’una al costat de l’altra, així que només les separa un semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
rows.translation: Quin parell de tecles blanques està separat per un semitò?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C i D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: F i G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: B i C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B and C have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Entre B i C no hi ha cap tecla negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
rows.translation: Quants semitons hi ha de C amunt fins a E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: quatre moviments d’una tecla cadascun.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
rows.translation: Toca o canta els dos semitons entre tecles blanques: d’E a F i després de B a C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sostinguts i bemolls
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · title

rows.translation: Sostingut i bemoll
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
rows.translation: Un sostingut (♯) puja una nota un semitò. Un bemoll (♭) la baixa un semitò. La tecla negra just per damunt de C és C♯; la de just per sota de D és D♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
rows.translation: Què fa un sostingut a una nota?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La baixa un semitò
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La puja un to
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La puja un semitò
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
rows.translation: Aquesta tecla negra és just per damunt de F. Quin nom té amb sostingut?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
rows.translation: Puja F un semitò i obtens F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
rows.translation: La mateixa tecla és just per sota de G. Quin nom té amb bemoll?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
rows.translation: Baixa G un semitò i obtens G♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Dos noms, una tecla
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
rows.translation: Cada tecla negra pot rebre el nom de la blanca de sota, amb sostingut, o de la blanca de sobre, amb bemoll. C♯ i D♭ són la mateixa tecla.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a half step below B?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un semitò per sota de B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
rows.translation: Baixa B un semitò i obtens B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
rows.translation: És la tecla de la dreta del parell, just per damunt de D: D♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
rows.translation: Toca o canta C, C♯, D: dos semitons amunt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · title

rows.translation: Dos semitons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
rows.translation: Un to equival a dos semitons: se salta exactament una tecla. De C a D hi ha un to, amb C♯ entremig. D’E a F♯, també.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a whole step above C?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per damunt de C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: De C a D se salta una tecla, C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step above E?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per damunt d’E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
rows.translation: D’E a F només hi ha un semitò, així que un to amunt és F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step above B?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per damunt de B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
rows.translation: De B a C hi ha un semitò, així que un to amunt és C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step below F?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per sota de F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
rows.translation: De F avall fins a E hi ha un semitò; una tecla més avall és E♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.translation: Toca o canta dos tons amunt des d’E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Una tecla, dos noms
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · title

rows.translation: Notes enharmòniques
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
rows.translation: Dos noms per a la mateixa altura es diuen enharmònics. C♯ i D♭ són una tecla amb dos noms. El nom que fas servir depèn de la tonalitat en què ets.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair names the same key?
rows.translation: Quin parell anomena la mateixa tecla?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C♯ i D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: D♯ i E
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C♯ i D♭
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
rows.translation: C♯ és un semitò per damunt de C; D♭ és un semitò per sota de D. La mateixa tecla.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin altre nom té G♯?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
rows.translation: G♯ i A♭ són la mateixa tecla negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Les tecles blanques també
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
rows.translation: Les tecles blanques també poden tenir noms amb sostingut o bemoll. E i F estan separades per un semitò, així que E♯ és la mateixa tecla que F, i F♭, la mateixa que E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E♯ is played on which key?
rows.translation: En quina tecla es toca E♯?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
rows.translation: E♯ és un semitò per damunt d’E, és a dir, F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin altre nom té C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
rows.translation: B♯ és un semitò per damunt de B, és a dir, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
rows.translation: La tecla negra entre F i G és F♯. Quin altre nom té?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
rows.translation: Toca o canta B♭, C, D. B♭ és la mateixa tecla que A♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte de sostinguts i bemolls
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · title

rows.translation: Passos i noms
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
rows.translation: Semitons, tons, sostinguts, bemolls i notes amb dos noms, tot barrejat. Imagina el teclat mentre respons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a half step above B?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un semitò per damunt de B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: What is a whole step above A?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per damunt d’A?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
rows.translation: D’A a B se salta una tecla, A♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin altre nom té E♭?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
rows.translation: E♭ i D♯ són la mateixa tecla negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
rows.translation: És la tecla més aguda del grup de tres, just per sota de B: A♯, també anomenada B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step below D?
rows.translation: Quina nota és un to per sota de D?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: De D a C se salta una tecla, C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
rows.translation: Toca o canta D, E, F♯, G: to, to i després semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Llegir el pentagrama
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 “Reading the staff” · title

rows.source: Treble clef lines and spaces, ledger lines, and a first look at bass clef.
rows.translation: Línies i espais en clau de sol, línies addicionals i una primera mirada a la clau de fa.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 “Reading the staff” · unit summary

rows.translation: Línies i espais
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · title

rows.translation: El pentagrama
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
rows.translation: La música s’escriu en un pentagrama: cinc línies amb quatre espais entremig. Les notes van en una línia o en un espai. Com més amunt és una nota, més aguda sona.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many lines does a staff have?
rows.translation: Quantes línies té un pentagrama?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
rows.translation: Cinc línies, amb quatre espais entremig.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quina nota és més aguda?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
rows.translation: És més amunt al pentagrama, així que sona més aguda.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Línia, espai, línia
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.translation: Pujar una lletra vol dir passar d’una línia a l’espai següent o d’un espai a la línia següent. Les notes de línies veïnes estan separades per dos passos de lletra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.translation: Una nota en una línia puja una lletra. On arriba?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A l’espai següent de sobre
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A la línia següent de sobre
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dues línies més amunt
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Les lletres s’alternen: línia, espai, línia, espai.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Línies en clau de sol
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · title

rows.translation: La clau de sol
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.translation: La clau de sol, o clau de G, s’enrosca al voltant de la segona línia començant per baix. Aquesta línia és el G per damunt del C central. La llegeixen els instruments i les veus aguts.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.translation: Quina nota hi ha a la segona línia del pentagrama en clau de sol?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.translation: La clau de sol s’enrosca en aquesta línia per marcar G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: De baix a dalt, les línies en clau de sol són E, G, B, D, F. Recorda-les amb «Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: La línia de baix és E, d’«Els», a «Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: La línia del mig és B, de «Blancs», a «Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: La línia de dalt és F, de «Fora», a «Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: La quarta línia començant per baix és D, de «Dormen», a «Els Gats Blancs Dormen Fora».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Toca o canta les tres línies de baix: E, G, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Espais en clau de sol
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title

rows.translation: FACE als espais
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: Els quatre espais en clau de sol formen una paraula anglesa de baix a dalt: F, A, C, E. Els espais formen FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: L’espai de baix és F, la primera lletra de FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: El tercer espai començant per baix és C: F, A, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: El segon espai començant per baix és A: F, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Línies i espais junts
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.translation: Ajunta’ls i el pentagrama puja E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: línia, espai, línia, espai, fins a dalt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: L’espai de dalt és E, l’última lletra de FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: La segona línia començant per baix és G, on s’enrosca la clau de sol.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Toca o canta els espais de baix a dalt: F, A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Línies addicionals i C central
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title

rows.translation: Línies addicionals
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Quan una nota va per sobre o per sota del pentagrama, unes línies curtes, dites addicionals, l’allarguen. El C central és en una línia addicional just sota el pentagrama en clau de sol.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: Una línia addicional sota el pentagrama en clau de sol és el C central.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D és a l’espai just sota la línia de baix.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Per sobre del pentagrama
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Per sobre de la línia de dalt, el patró continua. G és just damunt de la línia de dalt, i A és a la primera línia addicional de sobre.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: Una línia addicional sobre el pentagrama en clau de sol és A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Compta avall: C central a la primera línia addicional, B a sota, A a la segona línia addicional.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Toca o canta el C central, després D i E, pujant de la línia addicional al pentagrama.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Bases de la clau de fa
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · title

rows.translation: La clau de fa
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Els instruments i les veus greus llegeixen la clau de fa, o clau de F. Els seus dos punts envolten la quarta línia començant per baix i marquen l’F per sota del C central.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.translation: Quina nota marquen els punts de la clau de fa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: La clau de fa és la clau de F: els punts emmarquen la línia d’F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Gats Blancs Dormen Feliços Arreu
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: Les línies en clau de fa, de baix a dalt, són G, B, D, F, A: «Gats Blancs Dormen Feliços Arreu». Els espais són A, C, E, G: «Alguns Cargols Estimen Gerds».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: La línia de baix en clau de fa és G, de «Gats», a «Gats Blancs Dormen Feliços Arreu».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: El segon espai començant per baix és C: «Alguns Cargols».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: La línia de dalt en clau de fa és A, d’«Arreu», a «Gats Blancs Dormen Feliços Arreu».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.translation: On és el C central en clau de fa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.translation: En una línia addicional sobre el pentagrama
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A la línia del mig
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A l’espai de baix
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: El C central és una línia addicional per sobre del pentagrama en clau de fa i una per sota del pentagrama en clau de sol.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Toca o canta els espais en clau de fa: A, C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte de lectura del pentagrama
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · title

rows.translation: Llegeix-lo d’un cop d’ull
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Línies, espais, línies addicionals i totes dues claus. Fes servir les frases per recordar i després prova de reconèixer cada nota d’un cop d’ull.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: El tercer espai començant per baix en clau de fa és E: «Alguns Cargols Estimen».
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Toca o canta el C central, després E, G i el C del tercer espai.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ritme i compàs
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · title

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.translation: Figures de rodona a semicorxera, puntets i silencis, i els compassos 4/4, 3/4 i 6/8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · unit summary

rows.translation: Pulsacions i compassos
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · title

rows.translation: La pulsació
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: La pulsació és el batec regular que marques amb el peu. Les pulsacions s’agrupen en compassos, en anglès bars o measures. En la majoria de música, cada compàs té quatre pulsacions.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Compta cada compàs
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Compta cada compàs en veu alta: 1, 2, 3, 4. El temps 1, el primer temps, sol ser el més fort. Marca’l una mica més.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.translation: Què vol dir «measure» en música?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pulsació
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Silenci
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Compàs
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Els mots anglesos bar i measure volen dir compàs.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin temps sol ser el més fort?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Temps 4
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Temps 1
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Temps 3
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: El temps 1, el primer temps, inicia cada compàs.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rodones, blanques i negres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title

rows.translation: Valors de les notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: La forma d’una nota indica quant dura. En un compàs de quatre pulsacions, una rodona dura les quatre pulsacions; una blanca, dues, i una negra, una.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.translation: Quantes pulsacions dura una blanca?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: Dues blanques omplen un compàs de quatre pulsacions.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Quantes negres omplen un compàs de quatre pulsacions?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: Una negra dura una pulsació, així que quatre omplen el compàs.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quina dura més?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una rodona
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Una rodona dura quatre pulsacions; una blanca, dues, i una negra, una.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Barreja-les
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: Un compàs pot barrejar valors, sempre que sumin el que cal. Una blanca i dues negres omplen quatre pulsacions: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Corxeres i semicorxeres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Una corxera dura mitja pulsació, així que n’hi caben dues per pulsació. Compta 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i, dient «i» entre les pulsacions.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.translation: Una corxera dura mitja pulsació.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Una semicorxera dura un quart de pulsació, així que n’hi caben quatre per pulsació. Compta 1 e i a, 2 e i a.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Quantes semicorxeres equivalen a una negra?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Una negra és una pulsació, i en una pulsació hi caben quatre semicorxeres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Quantes corxeres omplen un compàs de quatre pulsacions?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Dues per pulsació, quatre pulsacions: vuit corxeres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Puntets i silencis
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title

rows.translation: Notes amb puntet
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Un puntet després d’una nota hi afegeix la meitat del seu valor. Una blanca dura dues pulsacions, així que amb puntet en dura tres. Una negra amb puntet dura una pulsació i mitja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: La meitat de dos és un, així que el puntet afegeix una pulsació: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Silencis
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Un silenci té una durada mesurada. Cada valor de nota té un silenci equivalent: el de negra dura una pulsació; el de blanca, dues. Continua comptant durant els silencis.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Una negra és una pulsació; el puntet hi afegeix la meitat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Un compàs de quatre pulsacions té una blanca i una negra. Què omple el buit?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un silenci de negra
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un silenci de blanca
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Un silenci de rodona
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, així que queda una pulsació: un silenci de negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Indicacions de compàs
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title

rows.translation: Llegir una indicació de compàs
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Els dos números l’un sobre l’altre al començament d’una peça són la indicació de compàs. El de dalt compta les pulsacions per compàs. El de baix indica quina figura val una pulsació: 4 vol dir negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: En 4/4, quantes pulsacions de negra té un compàs?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: El 4 de dalt vol dir quatre pulsacions; el 4 de baix fa que cadascuna sigui una negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Compàs de 3/4
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: En 3/4, cada compàs té tres pulsacions de negra. Compta 1, 2, 3, amb el pes a l’1. És el balanceig d’un vals.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: En quin compàs sol estar un vals?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Un vals es compta de tres en tres: 1, 2, 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Compàs de 6/8
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: En 6/8, cada compàs té sis corxeres en dos grups de tres. Se sent com dues pulsacions grans, cadascuna dividida en tres: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Com se sol sentir el 6/8?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sis pulsacions iguals
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Dues pulsacions dividides en tres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Tres pulsacions dividides en dues
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Les corxeres s’agrupen 1 2 3, 4 5 6, així que sents dues pulsacions fortes per compàs.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: En 3/4, quina sola nota omple tot un compàs?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Una blanca amb puntet
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Tres pulsacions: una blanca (2) més el puntet (1).
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte de ritme
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · title

rows.translation: Compta i després pica
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Valors de notes, puntets, silencis i indicacions de compàs, tot junt. Compta en veu alta mentre piques; la veu manté les mans a compàs.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Quantes pulsacions dura una rodona en 4/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Quantes semicorxeres caben en una pulsació?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.translation: Què afegeix un puntet a una nota?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: El doble del seu valor
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La meitat del seu valor

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?

rows.translation: Res

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: El 3/4 té tres pulsacions; 1 + 1 = 2, així que en queda una.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
