rows.translation: Quantes corxeres té un compàs de 6/8?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Escales majors i tonalitats
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · title

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: La recepta de tons i semitons, quatre tonalitats majors i les seves armadures.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · unit summary

rows.translation: Una escala
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Una escala és un conjunt de notes que pugen en ordre des d’una tònica fins a la mateixa nota una octava més amunt. C major només fa servir tecles blanques: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Quantes lletres diferents té una escala major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Set lletres, i després la primera torna una octava més amunt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Aquesta escala puja o baixa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: On cauen els semitons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: En C major, la majoria de notes veïnes estan separades per un to. Només d’E a F i de B a C hi ha semitons. Aquesta distància desigual dona a l’escala el seu so.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: En C major, quins passos són semitons?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: De C a D i de F a G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: D’E a F i de B a C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: De D a E i d’A a B
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Entre E i F, i entre B i C, no hi ha cap tecla negra.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.translation: Quina és la tònica de C major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: La nota de repòs, anomenada tònica, dona nom a l’escala.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Toca o canta l’escala de C major, pujant des del C central.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: La recepta de l’escala major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · title

rows.translation: To, to, semitò
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Totes les escales majors segueixen una recepta de passos: to, to, semitò, to, to, to, semitò. Comença en qualsevol nota, segueix-la i construiràs una escala major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Quina és la recepta de l’escala major? (W = to, H = semitò)
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: To, to, semitò, to, to, to, semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Numera les notes de l’escala de l’1 al 8. On són els semitons?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: To, to i després semitò del 3 al 4; to, to, to i després semitò del 7 al 8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: És una escala major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Començant en G, un to amunt arriba a...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: De G a A se salta una tecla, G♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Toca o canta les quatre primeres notes de D major: to, to, semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Construir G major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Comença en G i segueix la recepta: G, A, B, C, D, E, després un to fins a F♯ i un semitò per tornar a casa, a G. G major té un sostingut: F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Per què G major necessita F♯ en lloc de F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.translation: F és massa greu per cantar-lo
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Els sostinguts sonen més lluminosos
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: D’E a F només hi ha un semitò
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: La recepta necessita un to de la nota 6 a la 7 i després un semitò de la 7 amunt fins a G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.translation: Quina nota és a G major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.translation: La setena nota de G major és F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.translation: Quants sostinguts té G major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cap
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només un: F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Toca o canta l’escala de G major. Recorda l’F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: D major i F major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · title

rows.translation: D major: dos sostinguts
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Des de D, la recepta dona D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major té dos sostinguts: F♯ i C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Quins dos sostinguts té D major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: F♯ i G♯
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C♯ i D♯
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: F♯ i C♯
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Seguint la recepta des de D, arribes a F♯ com a nota 3 i a C♯ com a nota 7.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: F major: un bemoll
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Des de F, la recepta necessita un semitò d’A a la quarta nota, així que és B♭, no B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Un bemoll: B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.translation: Quina nota és a F major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: La quarta nota de F major és B♭, un semitò per damunt d’A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.translation: Quina tonalitat major té dos sostinguts?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: D major té F♯ i C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Toca o canta pujant F major de F a C. La quarta nota és B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Armadures
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · title

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: En lloc d’escriure F♯ cada vegada, la música en G major posa un sostingut al començament de cada línia. És l’armadura: indica les notes que sempre són sostingudes o bemolls.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Una armadura té un sostingut, F♯. Quina tonalitat major és?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G major és la tonalitat major que només té F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Una armadura té un bemoll, B♭. Quina tonalitat major és?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F major és la tonalitat major que només té B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Una drecera amb sostinguts
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Els sostinguts sempre apareixen en el mateix ordre: F♯, C♯, G♯, etc. L’últim sostingut és un semitò per sota del nom de la tonalitat. Un sostingut, F♯: G major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Una armadura té dos sostinguts, F♯ i C♯. Quina tonalitat major és?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: L’últim sostingut, C♯, és un semitò per sota de D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Quina tonalitat major no té sostinguts ni bemolls?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.translation: C major només fa servir tecles blanques.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: L’armadura indica B♭. Quins B es toquen com a B♭?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Només el primer
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tots els B
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Només els aguts
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Una armadura s’aplica a tots els B de totes les octaves, tret que la música indiqui el contrari.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Toca o canta D major, amb els seus dos sostinguts: F♯ i C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Repte d’escales i tonalitats

rows.translation: Construeix-la i posa-hi nom

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: La recepta, quatre tonalitats i les seves armadures. Si dubtes, construeix l’escala des de la tònica: to, to, semitò, to, to, to, semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · challenge thy-5-6 “Scales and keys challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · challenge thy-5-6 “Scales and keys challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.translation: L’únic bemoll de F major és B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · challenge thy-5-6 “Scales and keys challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Quina escala té les notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · challenge thy-5-6 “Scales and keys challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: En totes les escales majors, quin pas és un semitò?

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: To, to, semitò: el primer semitò cau entre les notes 3 i 4.

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?

rows.translation: Dos sostinguts

rows.translation: Un bemoll

rows.translation: Toca o canta F major, amb el seu B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · challenge thy-5-6 “Scales and keys challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Anomena la distància entre dues notes pel número i el tipus, i mesura-la en semitons.

rows.translation: Comptar números d’interval
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · title

rows.translation: Compta les lletres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: El número d’un interval surt de comptar els noms de lletra, incloent-hi tots dos extrems. De C amunt fins a E comptem C, D, E: tres lletres, així que és una tercera.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C up to G is a...
rows.translation: De C cap amunt fins a G és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Quarta
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Quinta
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: cinc lletres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Segona
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: D, E, F: tres lletres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quin interval és aquest?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: quatre lletres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Els sostinguts no alteren el recompte
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Els sostinguts i els bemolls no canvien el número d’un interval. De C a E♭ i de C a E són terceres: C, D, E en tots dos casos. Tenen una distància diferent, que veurem tot seguit.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F up to D is a...
rows.translation: De F cap amunt fins a D és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Sisena
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: sis lletres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
rows.translation: D’A cap amunt fins a E♭ és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: cinc lletres. El bemoll no canvia el recompte.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: De G cap amunt fins al G següent és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Setena
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Novena
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: vuit lletres, una octava.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Terceres segons la distància
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · title

rows.translation: Compta semitons per mesurar
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Dos intervals amb el mateix número poden tenir distàncies diferents. Per mesurar amb exactitud, compta semitons. De C amunt fins a E n’hi ha quatre; de C fins a E♭, tres.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Quants semitons hi ha de D amunt fins a F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: tres moviments.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Una tercera de quatre semitons és major, com de C a E. Una tercera de tres és menor, com de C a E♭ o d’A a C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
rows.translation: D’E cap amunt fins a G♯ és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: D’E a G♯ hi ha quatre semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A up to C is a...
rows.translation: D’A cap amunt fins a C és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: D’A a C hi ha tres semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: De G cap amunt fins a B♭ és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: De G a B♭ hi ha tres semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Intervals justos
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · title

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Els unísons, les quartes, les quintes i les octaves s’anomenen justos. Una quarta justa abasta cinc semitons; una quinta justa, set, i una octava, dotze.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.translation: Quants semitons té una quinta justa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: De C amunt fins a G: set semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.translation: De C cap amunt fins a F és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: De C a F hi ha cinc semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.translation: Compte amb B i F
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: La majoria de quintes entre tecles blanques són justes, però de B amunt fins a F només hi ha sis semitons. Es diu quinta disminuïda. Si dubtes, compta semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Quina d’aquestes quintes és més petita que una quinta justa?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: De C a G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: De B a F
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: D’E a B
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: De B a F hi ha sis semitons; una quinta justa en necessita set.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A up to D is a...
rows.translation: D’A cap amunt fins a D és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: quatre lletres, cinc semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Segones, sisenes i setenes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · title

rows.translation: Intervals majors i menors
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Les segones, terceres, sisenes i setenes poden ser majors o menors. El menor sempre és un semitò més petit que el major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Les distàncies en semitons
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Segona menor 1, major 2. Tercera menor 3, major 4. Sisena menor 8, major 9. Setena menor 10, major 11.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.translation: De C cap amunt fins a A és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: De C a A hi ha nou semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: De C cap amunt fins a B♭ és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Setena major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Setena menor
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: De C a B♭ hi ha deu semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: D’E a F només hi ha un semitò.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.translation: Quants semitons té una setena major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Deu
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Onze
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.translation: Un semitò menys que una octava.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E up to C is a...
rows.translation: D’E cap amunt fins a C és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C forma una sisena. Abasta vuit semitons, així que és menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Repte d’intervals
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · title

rows.translation: Primer el número, després la distància
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Compta lletres per saber el número. Compta semitons per saber la distància. Tots dos junts donen nom a qualsevol interval.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: De F cap amunt fins a A és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A és una tercera, i els quatre semitons la fan major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.translation: De D cap amunt fins a A és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: De D a A hi ha set semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: De B cap amunt fins a D és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D és una tercera de tres semitons: menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.translation: Quants semitons té una sisena major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Nou
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.translation: De G cap amunt fins a F és una...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: De G a F hi ha set lletres i deu semitons: una setena menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Acords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · title

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Apila terceres per fer tríades, construeix acords majors i menors i numera els acords d’una tonalitat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: Construir una tríada
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · title

rows.translation: Apilar terceres
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Una tríada són tres notes apilades per terceres. Comença en qualsevol nota, salta’t una lletra, pren la següent i torna a saltar. C, salta D, E, salta F, G: C E G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Quines notes formen una tríada sobre G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, salta A, B, salta C, D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fonamental, tercera, quinta
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: La nota sobre la qual es construeix una tríada és la fonamental. La del mig és la tercera i la de dalt, la quinta, segons la distància per damunt de la fonamental.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: A la tríada F A C, quina nota és la fonamental?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F és la nota de baix sobre la qual es construeix la tríada.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: A la tríada D F A, quina nota és la quinta?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: De D amunt fins a A és una quinta: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Amb només tecles blanques, quina tríada es construeix sobre E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, salta F, G, salta A, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Toca o canta la tríada de C, nota a nota: C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Tríades majors i menors
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · title

rows.translation: Tríades majors
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Una tríada major té una tercera major a baix, de quatre semitons, i després una tercera menor a dalt. C E G és major. F A C i G B D també.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Inverteix l’ordre de les terceres i obtens menor: una tercera menor a baix i després una de major. Baixa la nota del mig de C major i obtens C menor: C E♭ G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quines notes formen D menor?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: De D a F és una tercera menor; de F a A, una tercera major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quines notes formen E major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: D’E a G♯ és una tercera major; de G♯ a B, una tercera menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: A C E és major o menor?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: D’A a C és una tercera menor, tres semitons.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Toca o canta A menor, nota a nota: A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Els acords d’una tonalitat
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · title

rows.translation: Acords a partir d’una escala
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Construeix una tríada sobre cada nota d’una escala, només amb les notes d’aquella escala, i tindràs la família d’acords de la tonalitat. C major en té set, un per nota.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Amb només notes de C major, quina tríada es construeix sobre D?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D disminuït
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: una tercera menor i després una de major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Amb només notes de C major, quina tríada es construeix sobre G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G disminuït
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: una tercera major i després una de menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: L’acord disminuït
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: La tríada sobre B és diferent: B D F. Totes dues terceres són menors, així que és una tríada disminuïda. Sona tensa i demana moviment.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: En C major, quins acords són majors?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D, E i A
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C, F i G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C i G B D tenen cadascun una tercera major a baix.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.

rows.translation: Toca o canta la tríada disminuïda sobre B: B, D, F.

rows.translation: Numerar els acords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Els músics numeren els acords d’una tonalitat amb números romans: I per a l’acord de la nota 1, fins a vii per a la nota 7. Majúscula vol dir major; minúscula, menor, i °, disminuït.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: El patró de la tonalitat major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Totes les tonalitats majors segueixen un patró: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. En C major són C, D menor, E menor, F, G, A menor i B disminuït.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: En C major, quin acord és IV?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: La quarta nota de C major és F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: En C major, quin acord és vi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: La sisena nota és A, i vi en minúscules vol dir menor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: En G major, quin acord és V?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Compta amunt des de G: G, A, B, C, D. La cinquena nota és D, i V és major.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Per què ii s’escriu en minúscules?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: És un acord fluix

rows.translation: Es toca més agut

rows.translation: És un acord menor
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: En G major, quin acord és IV?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C menor
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: la quarta nota és C.

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.translation: Forma’l, escolta’l i numera’l
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Apila terceres, comprova’n les distàncies i situa l’acord a la tonalitat: major a I, IV i V; menor a ii, iii i vi, i disminuït a vii°.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Quines notes formen G major?

rows.translation: Quines notes formen A menor?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: En C major, quin acord és ii?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: En F major, quin acord és V?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: la cinquena nota és C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Quina tríada és disminuïda?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction
